column1: Totango Field Value Discrepancy
column11:
Hi team, 



The following field in Totango is showing different values than when I calculate in Snowflake from the source table: {{HS20_COURSE_STARTED_90_DAYS}} on the Totango Account. 

Ex. 

# Ford Motor Company (ID: 8811761a-3d0d-4010-8909-0b02e19f4e03) 
## Totango: 13 courses started
## Snowflake: 4 courses started
# Unilever [Tender] (ID: f438a210-5213-4ebe-a1a1-2809a4f2b587) 
## Totango: ~1,000 courses started (L90D)
## Snowflake: ~220 courses started since start of 2026



The field should be calculating the number of courses started in the Last 90 Days, aggregated at a working account level. Below is the logic used to calculate the value in Snowflake from the source tables. Can you confirm the logic used in Totango? 



{noformat}with  academy_enrollments AS (
  SELECT
    e.id AS enrollment_id,
    e.user_id,
    e.course_id,
    e.created_at::date   AS created_date,
    e.started_at::date   AS started_date,
    e.completed_at::date AS completed_date,
    e.completed          AS completed_flag,
    CASE WHEN e.started_at IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS started_flag,
    e.percentage_completed,
    c.name AS course_name
  FROM MW_SOURCE_SS.THINKIFIC.ENROLLMENT e
  LEFT JOIN MW_SOURCE_SS.THINKIFIC.COURSE c
    ON e.course_id = c.id
),

totango_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    totango_user_user_id AS user_id,
    salesforce_account_id AS account_id,
    working_level_account_id,
    totango_user_email,
    totango_user_account_role AS user_role
  FROM dwh.totango.totango_user
),

user_details AS (
  SELECT
    u.id AS user_id,
    u.email,
    u.created_at::date AS user_created_at,
    t.account_id,
    t.working_level_account_id,
    t.user_role
  FROM MW_SOURCE_SS.THINKIFIC.USERS u
  LEFT JOIN totango_users t
    ON t.user_id = u.email
  WHERE u.email NOT ILIKE '%meltwater%'
)


  SELECT
    ud.account_id,
    ud.working_level_account_id,
    ae.enrollment_id,
    ae.user_id,
    ae.course_id,
    ae.course_name,
    ae.created_date,
    ae.started_date,
    ae.completed_date,
    ae.completed_flag,
    ae.started_flag
  FROM academy_enrollments ae
  LEFT JOIN user_details ud
    ON ae.user_id = ud.user_id
  WHERE ud.account_id IS NOT NULL{noformat}

The final value is a count of enrollment IDs where Started Flag is TRUE, and Started Date is in the Last 90 Days.

For other reps it normally shows, as this PLI has been set that way since last year. So two asks here would be:



# [Florian is set up as an Enterprise New Logo role|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/User/005Rf000003eUdZIAU/view]. Can you please look into his profile and see why the Selling Org setup that includes both CA and Enterprise would not show that PLI for him? And

column16: 25/Apr/26 3:23 AM;557058:d20b7121-5766-474b-aac2-87ddac585d67;Thanks Peter for submitting the ticket, We’ll have team investigate and we can discuss on our weekly call next week.
column17:
28/Apr/26 4:41 AM;557058:d20b7121-5766-474b-aac2-87ddac585d67;Hi Peter, 
Team did investigation and here are the result:
A search filter called *“*[+*Filter by User’s Selling Org*+|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/SBQQ__SearchFilter__c/a2jRf000000PvxbIAC/view]*”* controls which products appear in Contract Builder. Products are shown only when the product’s {{Selling_Org__c}} matches the Quote’s {{WD_Subdivision_Text__c}}.

{{WD_Subdivision_Text__c}} is a formula field derived from the Quote owner’s {{WD_Subdivision__c}}.

*Root Cause (Q-71125):*
Quote history indicates the previous Sales Rep was an integration user. While owner history isn’t tracked separately, the Sales Rep and Owner fields remain in sync. Since the integration user had a blank {{WD_Subdivision__c}}, {{WD_Subdivision_Text__c}} was populated incorrectly, causing products with a defined Selling Org to be excluded by the search filter logic.

*Workaround:*
Update/check the Quote owner so {{WD_Subdivision_Text__c}} reflects the correct value and aligns with the search filter.

*Next Steps:*
For broader improvement, the BizApps Team can review this implementation and discuss in our upcoming call to update the formula logic if needed.

column1: Best Practice Bulk Upload Contacts in SFDC
column11:
Hi team! 

This is a request from colleague [~accountid:712020:d0fef2b5-f1e2-4410-96a6-7d454c345f11] who was sharing some struggles when it comes to uploading contacts in bulk to SFDC. 

Reason this is needed is to make sure they can be added to gong sequences and the activity is tracked in Gong (only contacts living in SFDC can be tracked in Gong). 



Here is the full message: 

Hi team,

We’re currently struggling to get Gong Engage to work properly because we can’t easily update or upload contact details in Salesforce (SFDC).

We have a DMU list of around 500 contacts that we manage in a Google Sheet. Previously, we could easily import these into Mixmax and start sequences, but that’s no longer possible.

With Gong, SFDC is used as the main contact database, which makes sense. However, in practice, updating contacts in SFDC is quite difficult. There are too many required fields, and updating via LinkedIn Sales Navigator doesn’t work well either. The system blocks updates if there are duplicates, if the wrong account is selected, or if a contact already exists but with outdated information (e.g. wrong title) or just without a clear error notification. As a result, everything needs to be updated manually, which is not feasible for 500 contacts.

The urgent issue is that we want to send invitations for an executive dinner on May 21 and start a Gong Engage sequence. But we can only do this with contacts in SFDC. So we need a quick way to import our DMU list into SFDC.

This might create some duplicates, but those already exist in SFDC, so that’s not the main concern.

Can someone help us find a quick solution to this, so we can move forward and drive attendance for the event?

Thanks!

Sanne

The team checked and following is their Impact Analysis.

*Salesforce:*

* Updating the Account, Opportunity, and Parent New Business Opportunity will impact related objects such as Orders, Quotes, Contracts, Renewal Opportunities, Approval records, and associated credit records.
* Several fields (e.g., ACV, Product Group, etc.) across both Accounts and Opportunities will need recalculation.
* There is a risk of data inconsistencies that may not be immediately visible.

*Downstream Systems:*

* *NetSuite:* Account details in order records will need to be updated.
* *MI:* Entitlements will require re-synchronization.
* *Warpzone:* A resync will be necessary.
* *Totango:* Data updates will be required.
* *CRM MI Services:* Potential impacts will need to be reviewed and assessed.

*Conclusion:*
Moving an order from one account to another has significant impact across Salesforce and downstream systems, and is not a recommended approach.

It is advised that the sales rep rebooks the order under the correct account and cancel the existing order as a write-off.  

Regards,
Aviral Paliwal

column1: Production | Investigation | Opportunity and Quote Currency is Auto updated
column11:
We got a [request |https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04BB2E32M7/p1775056667006999]from Hazem Elsaeed to investigate why the opportunity and quote  currency gets updated while creating the quote.

Example Opportunity: [https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006PH00000kYtE5YAK/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006PH00000kYtE5YAK/view|smart-link] 

*Opportunity is created with the Currency:* USD

*Currency is updated for Opportunity and Quote:* AED

!image-20260401-154959.png|width=315,alt="image-20260401-154959.png"!

!image-20260401-155010.png|width=315,alt="image-20260401-155010.png"!



*Original Request:*

Hey team, just flagging a recurring issue we’re facing in Dubai when creating quotes for Saudi clients.
Even when the opportunity currency is originally USD and both billing and shipping addresses are in KSA, the system auto-converts the quote to AED once it’s generated.
[https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006PH00000kYtE5YAK/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006PH00000kYtE5YAK/view|smart-link] 
This ends up requiring manual intervention from SOPS every time, which is time-consuming and slows things down.
When trying to change it back to USD in Salesforce, we get this error:
“Currency selection you made is incompatible with existing primary quotes…”
This has been happening consistently, so would really appreciate if we can get this looked at and fixed soon.
column16:
01/Apr/26 9:23 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Hazem,

This is a tracking ticket for the [issue|https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04BB2E32M7/p1775056667006999] you raised for “Opportunity and Quote Currency is Auto updated”.

BizApps team will investigate it and keep you posted.

Thanks,
Mukesh
column17:
01/Apr/26 11:25 PM;5ebc09a3ddd45f0b94702129;Hi Mukesh,

Thank you for raising the ticket.

Just to confirm, this is not an isolated case tied to the referenced opportunity. It’s a recurring issue impacting the Dubai team when creating quotes for Saudi clients more broadly. We would appreciate implementing a permanent fix to prevent this from happening going forward.

Best,

Hazem
column18:
10/Apr/26 7:22 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Hazeem,

Update from BizApps team:

* It appears that the user initially created the Quote with AED currency, which subsequently updated the Opportunity currency to AED.
* Currently, there are two Quotes(out of total 3) associated with the Opportunity, both created in AED currency.
* A new Quote has now been created in USD which is Primary quote and Opportunity currency is showing as USD [https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/a2ePH000001vwJdYAI/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/a2ePH000001vwJdYAI/view]

Let me know if we are good to close this ticket or you have any questions.

Thanks,
Mukesh

10/Apr/26 9:34 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Hazeem,

I have passed it to the BizApps team to check it further and will keep you posted.

Regards,
Mukesh
column21:
13/Apr/26 5:31 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Hazeem,

BizApps team came with below:

* As per the Quote records, the currency used during quote creation is *AED*. There are two such records, as once a quote is created in a specific currency, it cannot be modified.

column1: Setting up Client Workspaces for GenAI Lens
column11:
I wanted to align on the best structure for supporting agency clients using GenAI Lens across both pitch and ongoing client work.

Today, agencies are purchasing a pitch license under their primary account. For ongoing client engagements, we’d ideally provision a separate GenAI Lens license to keep usage, prompts, and reporting segmented by client.

Given current limitations at the workspace level, we see two potential paths:

*Option 1: Separate MI Company under the agency account*

Create an additional MI company tied to the same agency account that holds the pitch license.

* Requires correct opportunity mapping so orders are entitled to the appropriate MI company. Support mentioned this has to be done correctly if you could advise

Upsell opps do not create an additional MI company, only Newbiz opps do so that looks like the pickl here.

* Re-map the Parent Newbiz opp on this [upsell opp|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000XuktCIAR/view] to be that newbiz opp that has just been created

Let me know if this helps or if you need any more info here.

Have a nice day,

column1: How RFP is populated
column11: Hi team, what is the RFP field based on? When does it refresh? For example if a client renews and we won the RFP, will it always stay as true or change at some point? Would be great to understand the logic behind. Thanks
column16:
20/Mar/26 5:23 PM;62f15545e50f2f2a39565bf5;Hi Corinna,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We are looking into this and will update you soon.

Regards,
Aviral Paliwal
column17:
23/Mar/26 12:46 PM;62f15545e50f2f2a39565bf5;Hi Corrina,

We’ve completed the investigation on the *RFP field behavior*.
Please find the summary below:
*Field Logic:*

* The RFP field is driven by the *“Tender_RFP_RFI__c”* checkbox on the Opportunity.
* It is *manually controlled* and not dependent on any other fields or system logic.

*Update Mechanism:*

* The checkbox is updated manually by the Sales Rep.
* Once selected, it reflects immediately and appends *“Tender”* to the Opportunity Name.
* There is *no batch job or automated recalculation* involved.

*Lifecycle Behavior:*

* The RFP field is *not carried forward in renewals*.
* Even if it’s selected on the original New Business Opportunity, it won’t auto-populate on Renewal Opportunities.
* It needs to be *reviewed and updated manually* for each opportunity.

Regards,
Aviral Paliwal

10/Apr/26 6:46 PM;557058:88d83e2d-43e4-43a5-b31a-33176fc7a7c5;Hi [~accountid:5ebc08eba39bb50bb1419557] ,

Thanks for sharing the details.

In the current implementation:

* Salesforce does not provide a way to grant or enable an entitlement for a customer unless that entitlement is included as a line item on one of the customer’s active orders.
* Although an entitlement that is not tied to an order line item can be added directly to the MI company within the MI platform, it comes with a limitation that the entitlement will be overwritten during the next entitlement sync triggered from Salesforce.

----

+Below is the investigation summary for Example:2+

Account ID: 0015f00001G6mwIAAR / MI Company Id: 696998984c481d9944a44231

* The above Account has one Active Order ([https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801PH00001LuzKPYAZ/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801PH00001LuzKPYAZ/view])
* The above Order does NOT have the Entitlement premium-print-australia-articles as an order line item ([https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801PH00001LuzKPYAZ/related/OrderItems/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801PH00001LuzKPYAZ/related/OrderItems/view])
* Hence, the entitlement in consideration is NOT synced to MI.

----

+Below is the reason why the entitlement premium-print-australia-articles is not added as an order line item:+

* The entitlement [premium-print-australia-articles|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/SBQQ__ProductOption__c/a2TPH000001QZ812AG/view] was configured to PLI [Australian Premium Print Content - CAL (Up to 100 clicks)|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Product2/01tRf00000CVBptIAH/view] on 3/3/2026
* While the [Quote |https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/SBQQ__Quote__c/a2ePH000001ahVhYAI/view]of the Order was created on 2/4/2026. This Quote also does not have the entitlement premium-print-australia-articles as a [quote line item|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/SBQQ__Quote__c/a2ePH000001ahVhYAI/related/SBQQ__LineItems__r/view].

----

*Conclusion:* Because the entitlement was associated with the product after the Quote/Order had already been created, it was not included as a line item in either the Quote or the Order, and therefore was not synced to the MI company.

We are currently working with SalesOps to design a mechanism that can support use cases like the one described above. Please refer to the placeholder ticket below:

[https://meltwater.atlassian.net/browse/BASD-38784|https://meltwater.atlassian.net/browse/BASD-38784|smart-link] 

The current workaround for applying the missing entitlement is to coordinate with the MI team to add the entitlement directly to the MI company within the MI platform, as the entitlements outside order line item cannot be enforced from Salesforce.

[~accountid:5dea7c4f08d48c0d13ad68e2] , [~accountid:5dea7c6a8743750d00b83aec], [~accountid:5e84f77fdde1d50c1df2b6e5] , [~accountid:60b7f4cc46e2780068a1accb]   please review the above and provide your feedback/guidance on this.

----

[~accountid:5ebc08eba39bb50bb1419557] Please let us know if the above investigation summary addresses your question regarding the entitlement discrepancy, or if you would like us to investigate additional examples as well?

Thanks

column16:
18/Mar/26 3:23 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi [@carmen|https://meltwater.slack.com/team/U55KRD97U], BizApps team did the investigation with below details:


* *1st Rebill Process:* MI Company is moved to Rebill Opportunity ([Amendment for contract #00145460|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/006Rf00000RIdrQIAT/view]) when order ([00393000|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/801Rf00000UG6gCIAT/view]) is rebilled and Rebill order ([00394350|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/801Rf00000VMznmIAD/view]) is created.
* Later on Rebill order ([00394350|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/801Rf00000VMznmIAD/view]) is updated as Closed Lost Rebilled, which updated Rebill Opportunity ([Amendment for contract #00145460|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/006Rf00000RIdrQIAT/view]) to *c*lose Lost Rebilled. (*Note: it was not done by the Rebill process in Salesforce, but it was done via a Rebill option on Credit Memo on Netsuite*)
* New rebill order is *not* created against the first rebill order Rebill order ([00394350|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/801Rf00000VMznmIAD/view]). As per flow, MI company moves to Rebill opportunity once rebill Order is created and approved.
* This account has 2 orders and both are Closed Lost Rebilled.

*Conclusion:*

* The rebill process was not initiated in Salesforce that  creates a new Amendment opportunity and Order.
* It was just an Order status update from Netsuite Credit Memo with option "Rebill".
* MI Company remained with first rebill opportunity which is correct as new rebill order and rebill opportunity was not created

We'll list out the similar cases and keep you posted.

Thanks,
Mukesh
column17:
19/Mar/26 5:46 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi [@carmen|https://meltwater.slack.com/team/U55KRD97U],
Here is the [report |https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Report/00OPH00000ACxUn2AL/view]with 34 cases.

*Based on the current implementation:*

* When a *credit memo (write-off)* is created in NetSuite and synced to Salesforce, the *Order State* is updated to _Cancelled_.
* When a *credit memo (rebill)* is created in NetSuite and synced to Salesforce, the *Order State* is updated to _Cancelled – Rebilled_.

*However, in both cases:*

* The *Opportunity Stage* is set to *“Closed Lost – Rebilled.”*





*Difference between the two scenarios:*

* *In regular Rebill case on Salesforce:*
** A new rebill opportunity is created. Once the new order is booked, the *MI Company* is moved from the original _New Business_ opportunity to the new rebill opportunity.
* *Write-off (churn) case on Netsuite:*
** No new opportunity is created. The *MI Company* remains linked to the original opportunity, which is marked as *“Closed Lost – Rebilled.”*

*Conclusion:*

* Currently there are 34 Opportunities marked as  *“Closed Lost – Rebilled* and having linked MI Company.

Thanks,
Mukesh

column1: Wire Pricing Hardblocker Not Firing Correctly on Renewal Opp
column11:
Hey team,

As I demoed on the call - if you lower the renewal length on a renewal opp that had an MYD, it can ignore the hard blocker on newswire min pricing (as a partner product). It doesn’t calculate the List Price correctly, as wires are not a product that should have a pro-rated price. It is quantity based pricing, same price irrespective of length.

You can see [on this renewal opp|https://meltwater--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000APEI7IAP/view], if you lower the length of the renewal to three months, the List Price dips well below COGS amount (and reps can still discount further from that per 10% discounting rules): 

!image-20260311-161637.png|width=1256,height=398,alt="image-20260311-161637.png"!

Can we fix this please?

Thanks!

Peter

column18:
13/Mar/26 7:02 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Peter,

Below is the update on this case:

+*Investigation 1: Lower List price*+
*Conclusion*

* There is *no issue with the Wire PLI List Price calculation*, as it correctly uses *fixed pricing values*. This behavior has been validated in the *Sandbox environment* across multiple scenarios, including *New Business, Amendment, and Renewal*, using *newly created records*.
* The issue in this *renewal opportunity* originates from an *incorrect List Price calculation in the Contract/Subscription record during migration*.
* This incorrect value was then *propagated to the Renewal Quote Line Items*, resulting in the lower list price displayed in the Quote Line Editor.



+*Investigation 2: Rule “Partner PLI Under Min Price” Not Triggering*+
*Conclusion*

* This appears to be an *implementation gap in the “Partner PLI Under Min Price” price rule*. The *Prorated_Minimum_Selling_Price__c* value is *neither recalculated nor copied from the previous order* for renewal quote lines, preventing the rule from triggering.

BizApps team will continue on the investigation/fix and will keep you posted for further updates.

Thanks,
Mukesh

I submitted a ticket through 6sense directly, and these were their instructions:

 

Hey Maddie,

Thank you for reaching out to 6sense Support. I would be happy to help you.

Based on the screenshot if appears that the 6sense Permission set has not been assigned to this user in Salesforce. I would request that you have your Salesforce Administrator assign the *6sense User Permission Set* to this user.
 

*To assign the 6sense User Permission in SFDC, follow the steps below:*

# From Setup, in the?Quick Find?box, enter?Users, then select?*Users*.
# Select a user.
# In the Permission Set Assignments related list, click?*Edit Assignments*.
# To assign a permission set, select it under Available Permission Sets, and click?*Add*. To remove a permission set assignment, select it under Enabled Permission Sets, and click?*Remove*.
# Save your changes.

Here is a document with more details for your reference - [+https://support.6sense.com/docs/installation-of-sales-intelligence-for-salesforce#6sense-sales-intelligence-user-permission-setup+|https://url.de.m.mimecastprotect.com/s/Mr49C79ExAHmx1AjJT8fpHopFFP?domain=support.6sense.com]

* If this process is manual, can you confirm whether the owner of the account/opportunity is responsible for updating the MI Lifecycle to _Former Prospect_?
* Would the preferred process be to update the MI Lifecycle at the end of a trial, or simply toggle off ‘Allow Login’?

An MI instance does not automatically change from _Prospect_ due to inactivity.

Regarding access, *Configure Access* is either automated based on the Contract End Date or managed manually by Patty’s team. However, when an MI instance is in _Prospect_ status, *Allow Login* remains set to _True_.

If needed, we can explore a mechanism to track trial status and link it to an MI Company status. This would require alignment and input from the RevOps, SalesOps, and Product Support teams.

05/Mar/26 1:54 PM;62f15545e50f2f2a39565bf5;Hi Yaisra,

Thank you for being patient. I checked with the team, and the following is the mechanism to track the MI Company Lifecycle.

Currently, the status of an MI instance is determined by a combination of the Client Opportunity flag, the Opportunity Stage, and the Latest Contract End Date (derived from Orders). The logic works as follows:

* If the *Client Opportunity* checkbox is marked as *True*, the MI instance is classified as *Customer*.
* If *Client Opportunity is not checked* and there is *no Latest Contract End Date*:
** If the *Opportunity Stage = Closed Lost*, the status becomes *Lost Prospect*.
** Otherwise, it remains *Prospect*.
* If a *Latest Contract End Date exists*:
** If the *Contract End Date is today or in the future*, the status is *Customer*.
** If the *Contract End Date expired within the last 93 days*, the status becomes *Win Back*.
** If the *Contract End Date expired more than 93 days ago*, the status is *Former Customer*.

Based on this logic, the lifecycle effectively behaves as:
*Prospect → Customer → Win Back → Former Customer*, with *Lost Prospect* representing prospects that reached a *Closed Lost* stage before becoming customers.

Please review and let me know if you have any questions.

Regards,
Aviral Paliwal

25/Feb/26 1:28 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Juri,

Update on this request:

h3. Investigation Summary

There is no functional issue with updating the *“CSM on Account Team”* field on the Account and Opportunity objects.

When a CSM is added, updated, or removed from the Account Team, the *“CSM on Account Team”* field on both the Account and related Opportunities is updated accordingly.

Testing was performed in the Production environment using a test account, and the functionality is working as expected.

Upon reviewing the report and performing spot checks on the data, the mismatch appears to have occurred in cases where the CSM was added to the Account Team *before the latest active flow versions were deployed*.

h3. Suggested Fix

A data backfill is required to correct the *“CSM on Account Team”* values on the Account and Opportunity objects where mismatches exist.

BzApps team will work on the fix and keep you posted.

Thanks,
Mukesh

07/Feb/26 1:53 AM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Meltwater Slack license Plan: Business+ Plan

h3. Option 1 — Built-In Slack AI (Business+ or Enterprise+)

Use Slack’s native AI capabilities to handle search and knowledge retrieval.

*Pros*

* Minimal maintenance
* Deep integration with Slack history and files
* No external bot hosting required

*Cons*

* Less customizable than a bespoke FAQ bot built by your team

h3. Option 2 — Custom AI Slackbot (Custom App + AI Backend)

* Build/choose a custom Slack App that uses Slack APIs to ingest FAQs + history + file content and answer questions using an AI model (like OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
* Can be installed on *Pro, Business+ or Enterprise+* — as long as the plan allows unlimited apps and full history access.

*Best with:*

* *Pro* for most cases (if cost-sensitive)
* *Business+* if you also want native Slack AI features alongside your bot





h2. How Slack Native AI uses your FAQ & knowledge

Slack AI *does not “train” like ChatGPT*, but it *searches and reasons over content you already have access to in Slack and connected apps*.

h3. It can pull answers from:

* 📄 *PDF files uploaded to Slack*
* 📁 *Google Drive files shared in Slack*
* 💬 *Public channels* (and private ones it has permission for)
* 📎 Slack files, messages, threads, and conversations

So your PDFs and Google Docs *are supported*, as long as they’re *visible in Slack*.

h2. Best way to feed your FAQ into Slack AI

h3. Option 1 (Recommended): Google Drive → Slack

# Store FAQs in *Google Docs / PDFs in Google Drive*
# Connect *Google Drive to Slack* (standard integration)
# *Share the files in a dedicated Slack channel*, e.g.
{{#faq-knowledge-base}}
# Pin the key docs in that channel

👉 Slack AI can now:

* Search those docs
* Pull relevant answers
* Cite content from them when users ask questions

h3. Option 2: Upload PDFs directly to Slack

# Upload FAQ PDFs directly into Slack
# Keep them in *one or more knowledge channels*
# Pin + clearly name files (this helps AI relevance)

Works fine, but *Drive is better for version control*.
column17:
07/Feb/26 2:04 AM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;h2. Goal (what we’re building)

When someone asks a question in Slack:

* Slack AI searches *approved FAQs*
* Pulls answers from *PDFs / Google Docs*
* Uses *marked, trusted channel replies*
* Avoids random chatter as much as possible

----

h2. STEP 1: Create an “AI-friendly” knowledge channel

Create *one primary source-of-truth channel*:

*Recommended name*

{noformat}#faq-knowledge-base
{noformat}

*Rules for this channel (important):*

* Public channel (AI works best here)
* Only:
** FAQ documents
** Approved answers
** Updates to existing answers
* No casual discussion

📌 Pin a short message at the top:

{quote}“This channel contains approved FAQs and official responses. Slack AI uses this content to answer questions.”{quote}

----

h2. STEP 2: Feed your FAQ documents (Google Drive / PDFs)

h3. ✅ If FAQs are in Google Drive (BEST option)

# Ensure *Google Drive is connected to Slack*
#* Workspace Settings → Integrations → Google Drive
# Share each FAQ doc *directly into* {{#faq-knowledge-base}}
# Pin every shared document
# Rename docs clearly, for example:
#* {{Salesforce_Access_FAQ_v1}}
#* {{CPQ_Licensing_FAQ}}
#* {{Onboarding_Process_FAQ}}

💡 Tip: Slack AI reads *document title + headings heavily*

----

h3. ✅ If FAQs are PDFs

# Upload PDFs directly to the same channel
# Use clean filenames (no “final_final_v3”)
# Pin them
# Add a short message below each PDF like:
{noformat}📘 Official FAQ – Salesforce Access
Covers: access request, approval flow, turnaround time
{noformat}

This helps Slack AI understand context.

----

h2. STEP 3: Mark “approved answers” in channels (this replaces training)

Slack AI *learns by signals*, not buttons. Use these signals consistently.

h3. How to mark an answer properly

When someone answers a question:

# Reply *in a thread*
# Start the reply with a strong marker:
{noformat}✅ Approved Answer:
{noformat}
# Keep it concise and structured
# Pin the reply

*Example*

{noformat}✅ Approved Answer:
CPQ licenses are requested via the CPQ Access form.
Once approved, licenses are provisioned within 24 hours.
{noformat}

📌 Slack AI prioritizes:

* Pinned messages
* Threaded answers
* Clear, authoritative tone

----

h2. STEP 4: Reduce noise so AI doesn’t get confused

This part matters more than people think.

h3. Do this:

* Keep FAQs out of chatty channels
* Move resolved Q&A into the knowledge channel
* Summarize long discussions into a single “Approved Answer”

h3. Avoid:

* Multiple conflicting answers in the same thread
* Casual “I think…” replies in FAQ channels
* Leaving outdated answers uncorrected

----

h2. STEP 5: Teach users _how_ to ask Slack AI

Share a short internal tip (you can pin this somewhere):

*How to ask Slack AI*

* “What is the process for CPQ licenses?”
* “Summarize the Salesforce onboarding steps”
* “Where is the official FAQ for access requests?”

Slack AI works best with *natural language*, not commands.

----

h2. STEP 6: Validate it’s working (quick test)

After setup:

# Open Slack AI search
# Ask:
#* “What is the CPQ license request process?”
#* “How do I get Salesforce access?”
# Check:
#* Does it reference your pinned docs?
#* Does it pull approved answers?
#* Is it ignoring noise?

If not:

* Rename files
* Improve headings
* Add clearer Approved Answers

----

h2. STEP 7: Ongoing maintenance (lightweight)

Weekly or bi-weekly:

* Review top repeated questions
* Convert them into:
** One pinned doc update, or
** One approved answer message
* Archive outdated content

Think *curation*, not management.

----

h2. What you now have

With Business+ and this setup:

* ✅ Native Slack AI (no custom bot)
* ✅ FAQ + Google Drive + PDFs searchable
* ✅ “Marked” answers via pinning & formatting
* ✅ Minimal admin overhead

07/Feb/26 2:09 AM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;h2. Where to find Slack AI Search

h3. Option 1: Top search bar (most common)

# Open Slack
# Look at the *very top of the app*
# Click the *Search bar* (or press *Ctrl + K* / *Cmd + K*)
# Type your question in *plain English*, for example:
#* _“What is the CPQ license request process?”_
#* _“Where is the Salesforce onboarding FAQ?”_

👉 When Slack AI is enabled, you’ll see:

* *AI-generated answers* at the top
* Followed by referenced messages/files/docs

This _is_ Slack AI search — there is no separate “AI screen”.

----

h3. Option 2: “Ask Slack AI” entry point (if enabled)

Depending on rollout in your workspace, you may see:

* A label like *“Ask Slack AI”*
* Or *“Summarize with AI”* / *“Get an answer”*

This appears:

* In the search results
* Or as a suggestion under the search box

⚠️ If you don’t see this, don’t panic — Slack is rolling this out gradually.

----

h3. Option 3: Right-click / message actions (contextual AI)

You may also see AI options when:

* Right-clicking a channel → *Summarize channel*
* Clicking the *three dots (⋯)* on a message
* Viewing a long thread

These confirm Slack AI is active.

----

h2. ✅ How to confirm Slack AI is enabled for your workspace

Ask a workspace admin to check:

*Workspace Settings → Billing → Plan*

* Should show *Business+*
* Slack AI should be listed under plan features

Or:
*Workspace Settings → Settings & permissions → AI*

If AI is disabled here, users won’t see AI search.

column23:
09/Feb/26 10:51 PM;5eb1939a86d01b0b7d0f5916;Hi team,

In order for us to award ACV here, the account would need to cover all existing GRR. This can only happen after the base is covered. 

If we’re thinking ACV first policy here, the rule is:

*ACV takes priority* +*unless*+ *the deal clearly qualifies as churn coverage under the rules below.*

*Renewal period rule: renewal base should always be covered first*

In any quarter where an account is renewing:

* *Renewal Base* = the customer’s existing recurring ARR up for renewal in that period.
* An incremental sale *on the* +*same account*+  is only treated as *Upsell (Growth)* in the amount that it is *over and above the Renewal Base*.
* Sales made to a related account, with clearly documented processes not intended to cover GRR do not cover the Renewal base.

*If a sale is made to a Customer Account with the intent of it covering GRR, all existing ARR must be covered and the additional amount (only) can be treated as an Upsell* (Example: selling add-on product while allowing part of the existing subscription to churn at the same time is not “upsell”; it’s retention and must be treated accordingly.)

An Upsell is only where you are selling more than what you need to renew at the same time. If for whatever reason there is a Cross Sale made on the same account that should be ACV and not Renewal, the Pod should be aligned on this fact at Proposal.

----

For the quarter here, we’re currently at a -7,500 change in ARR. Once this is covered and surpassed, we’ll be able to add ACV.

Best,
Chris

column1: Issue with Failed Order Integration
column11:
Order sync integration Failed due to the integration sets *AVATAX-CAN* purely based on the *order country = Canada*, without evaluating the *Subsidiary*. That’s why it attempted to send AVATAX-CAN for a *451 – Klear* [order|https://meltwater.my.salesforce.com/801PH00001GxWRxYAN], which NetSuite rejected.

Shilpa and Rajeev inputs:
Currently the integration sets *AVATAX-CAN* purely based on the *order country = Canada*, without evaluating the *Subsidiary*. That’s why it attempted to send AVATAX-CAN for a *451 – Klear* [order|https://meltwater.my.salesforce.com/801PH00001GxWRxYAN], which NetSuite rejected.
Based on this, we should tighten the logic so *AVATAX-CAN is only sent for the 111 – Canada subsidiary*, and not for Klear (or others), even if the address is Canada.

column1: Question regarding MI Company is missing in this rebill customer opp
column11:
Carmen has a [question |https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04BB2E32M7/p1769081177420489]in #salesforce-go-live:
MI Company is missing in this rebill customer opp. [https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006PH00000gZzGbYAK/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006PH00000gZzGbYAK/view|smart-link] 

Suchitra replied after checking on logic:
Hi [@carmen|https://meltwater.slack.com/team/U55KRD97U] the MI company lifecycle status logic is based on 
1.  Latest contract end date. 
2. Client opportunity flag. Since the latest contract end date is in future for this Amendment opp the MI company life cycle status is marked as Customer.. MI company is in the original opp and is moved only the rebill is completed. For this opp, the rebill is not completed, hence the MI company is still with Original opp. We have 2 action here.

# Data fix. Clear the latest contract end date so MI company life cycle status is selected correct on the opp
# Investigation: Check why 'Latest contract end date is populated when there is no order in the opp.

column17:
29/Jan/26 4:11 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Carmen,

Update on this case:

* Latest Contract end date is copied to Rebill opportunity through a Salesforce flow “+Opportunity | Rebill Initiator”+ although Rebill process is NOT completed.

Team is working on to fix it.

Mukesh
column18:
05/Feb/26 12:50 AM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Carmen,

BizApps team has fixed the Salesforce Automation for updating Latest Contract end date with rebill process.

# *Latest Contract End Date* field is updated on the New Business Opportunity when an Upsell Opportunity is created under it.
# *Latest Contract End Date* field is updated on the New Business Opportunity when an Product Swap Opportunity is created under it.
# *Lasted contract End Date* value should be removed when the associated order status is cancelled.
# *Latest Contract End Date* field value is cleared when the associated Order status is *Cancelled Rebill* and the Rebill Opportunity Order status is *Cancelled*.

Thanks,
Mukesh

column1: Question for PLIs and Entitlement changes
column11:
We got a [request |https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04H72LJQ9L/p1768573640836169] on [#bizapps-salesforce-crm|https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04H72LJQ9L] from Nicholas Patsiopoulos and John Box to check the impact of PLI and entitlement changes.

*Original Request:*

Team - John Box had a question about our ability to make PLI changes that ONLY impact users going forward - not existing customers. Obviously one way to do this is to create brand new PLIs, but this is cumbersome and causes unnecessary clutter.

* In any event, can you confirm whether there is any way to make changes to PLIs that impact only NEW customers (i.e. even if the existing users' accounts are updated). Current customers would get the updated PLIs upon renewal.
* Additionally, could you confirm if there's a way that customers could maintain their current PLI even AFTER renewal (i.e. their PLI terms stay the same as long as they keep renewing the same PLI)?
* We need to consider the Rebill orders in the analysis.
column16:
17/Jan/26 1:26 AM;712020:e0189f72-bdf5-4fef-9ff6-50fd430860ea;Hi  [~accountid:5c5b18f4a1405d31fa8f0a86],
The way Salesforce is configured right now, the entitlements that are attached to PLIs are not updated on existing customers or renewals when there are changes to the entitlement configuration in salesforce until a salesperson or admin takes an action to replace the old version of the PLI with the new one.
Users won't get the updated PLIs on renewals unless an active action is taken to replace them - if, for example, we want to do it on all open renewals, we’d need to run a mass update on the PLIs as admins. Salespeople can also update their quotes on an individual basis.
From some additional testing, this behavior is also the case for rebills - unless someone takes an action to replace the old PLI with the old entitlements with the new PLI, the entitlements won't change after the rebill.

There's a notable exception to this - Bundles. Rather than having the individual entitlements assigned to a PLI on the Salesforce side, the ID of the bundle is sent to the MI app, and the entitlements are added on the MI side based on that. If the entitlements for a bundle are changed on the MI side, I think they'd be updated whenever we next sync products over - but I'm not part of the backend for the MI team, so I'm less sure there.

column1: Request to install managed package: Mass Action Scheduler
column11:
SaaSCG’s CPQ team is requesting approval to install the *Mass Action Scheduler* managed package to support a required bulk process in Salesforce. This tool is needed to trigger and run a subflow for Auto-Renewals, which is necessary to carry forward documents from a prior Contract to a new Contract. This use case cannot be handled via Platform Events or standard scheduled flows. Mass Action Scheduler allows us to queue large volumes of records, process them in controlled batches, and automatically log success or failure before moving on to the next record which provides both resiliency and auditability. Building and maintaining an equivalent framework in-house would be significantly more complex and higher risk than leveraging this well-established package. While the original developer no longer actively maintains it, the package is widely adopted in the Salesforce community, has a strong operational track record, and is open enough that it can be supported or modified if needed. We have successfully used this tool across multiple customers for similar enterprise-scale scenarios.

Here is a link to the GitHub page: [https://github.com/sfdx-mass-action-scheduler|https://github.com/sfdx-mass-action-scheduler|smart-link]

Here is the update:

*Investigation:*

I reviewed the relevant records but was unable to determine the exact root cause of the issue.

column1: Hi team - question regarding requirements we could put into Salesforce when advancing an opportunity stage
column11:
I’m looking for support to implement stage progression gates within Salesforce Opportunities. This is an initiative from Scott Gibbs

The goal is to prevent a rep for example from moving an Opportunity from *Qualified* to *Evaluate* stage unless specific required fields or checkboxes are completed.

*Key requirements:*

# *Conditional gating:*
#* Reps should not be able to advance an Opportunity from _Qualified_ to _Evaluate_ unless predefined criteria are met (for example, certain checkboxes or fields completed).
#* These criteria will vary based on segment, so the gating should not apply universally to all Opportunities.
# *Segment-specific logic:*
We need the gating to apply differently depending on the Opportunity type. Two possible segmentation approaches:
#* *By Opportunity Owner Department* (e.g., SMB vs Mid-Market vs Enterprise)
#* *By ACV threshold* (e.g., apply only if projected ACV is above a specific amount)
# *Desired outcome:*
Create a rules-based mechanism that enforces stage progression requirements only for the relevant Opportunities, while allowing others (such as SMB) to progress without those conditions.

*Question for the team:*
Would Salesforce allow us to implement this based on either Owner Department or ACV threshold? Would one be simpler than the other?

Thanks
column16: 18/Dec/25 9:50 PM;557058:d20b7121-5766-474b-aac2-87ddac585d67;Hi Wellford, Thanks for submitting the ticket. We’ll check with the team on your questions and get back to you soon.
column17:
18/Dec/25 10:07 PM;712020:e0189f72-bdf5-4fef-9ff6-50fd430860ea;Hi Wellford - Yes, we already have quite a few stage-based validation gates in place in Salesforce requiring certain fields to be filled out for sales reps to move stages forward.

We can set rules based on user segment or ACV - for any value value on the opportunity, we can use it for the gating if necessary. 

We can do either or both for department or ACV threshold - My recommendation is to have it based on department rather than ACV as having a field the rep can edit (up to the point they create the quote) creates incentives for the sales team to misrepresent the value of the opportunity to move it forward faster. It may make sense to find some time to both do an overview of what rules are already in place, as well as talk through the new rules you’re looking to implement.

column19:
18/Dec/25 2:14 AM;557058:d20b7121-5766-474b-aac2-87ddac585d67;Checking with Wellford,
 I checked with Vel regarding the dashboard creation access in Salesforce.
*Summary of findings:*

* The ability to create dashboards is a *default Salesforce permission*.
* Historically, when Salesforce initially went live, this permission simply wasn’t included in the *Sales* profile, but there’s *no policy or functional rule* limiting Sales reps from having it.
* Vel reviewed several profiles (CSM, Finance, Sales Ops, RevOps), and *all of them except Sales already have dashboard-creation enabled*, which suggests there’s no intentional restriction in place.

17/Dec/25 12:22 AM;557058:d20b7121-5766-474b-aac2-87ddac585d67;Replied in #salesforce-go-live: 
Thanks for raising this.  We were able to investigate from the last few cases that you reported.
We found that the *Existing Contract End Date* on renewal opportunities is currently pulled from the *Contract End Date* on the renewed contract, but Reps often adjust the *Order End Date* on renewal orders which creating a mismatch when the contract date doesn’t update accordingly. As a result, the renewal opportunity displays an incorrect end date.
We have prioritize the defect for future fix. In the mean time, the w*orkaround is to* Update the _Existing Contract End Date_ on the renewal opportunity

column17: 16/Dec/25 5:28 AM;557058:d20b7121-5766-474b-aac2-87ddac585d67;[@peter.wolkow|https://meltwater.slack.com/team/UAHSV4YAD] [@Szabi Kiss|https://meltwater.slack.com/team/UCSB59W74] [@Ed van Niekerk|https://meltwater.slack.com/team/U05UH53DY8P] We discovered that the partner PLI minimum price [Product Rule|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/SBQQ__ProductRule__c/a2URf000000PGVLMA4/view?0.source=alohaHeader] does *not* trigger during the *initial quote creation through the Contract Builder*, allowing users to save quotes with pricing below the allowed minimums. The validation only fires when the quote is later opened and saved again in the *Quote Line Editor*. This gap in validation during the first-time Contract Builder flow is what allowed the invalid pricing to pass through undetected.Team has a log a ticket a prioritize to fix this bug: *Expected Result:* The system should *trigger a validation alert* and prevent the quote from being created when the partner PLI unit price is below the minimum allowed price. (edited)

column17:
11/Dec/25 11:21 PM;557058:d20b7121-5766-474b-aac2-87ddac585d67;[~accountid:5dea7c238389de0cd335ac22] [~accountid:5cd9d4334eeaaa0dd0b0329b] We checked and also with Salesforce Support, the agreement details and confirmed that the signer name shown in the PDF and Agreement record is coming *from Adobe Sign*, not from the Salesforce Contact record.

When the agreement was originally sent, Salesforce passed the signer’s *email* and a *recipient name* to Adobe. Adobe stored this name internally as {{signer1_fullname}} and used it to populate the PDF field {{{{*N_es_:signer1:fullname}}}}. After the agreement is sent, Salesforce does not overwrite or update this name.

In the Agreement's Recipient record in Salesforce, we can see the exact recipient name that was sent. This value does *not* necessarily match the Contact’s name. Adobe also may replace the name with the signer’s Adobe profile name, or with the name the signer typed during signing.

Because of this, the signer’s name in Adobe (and in the final PDF) can be different from the Salesforce Contact.Name even though the email address is the same. This is expected behavior based on how Adobe stores participant details.

I see {{GTM_PROCESSING_DB.DIM_SALESFORCE.DIM.INSTANCE.INSTANCE_IS_DELETED}} and {{GTM_PROCESSING_DB.DIM_SALESFORCE.DIM.INSTANCE.OPPORTUNITY_IS_DELETED}} , but when I crosscheck against company_ids that have been soft deleted, both flags still say false. column16: 05/Dec/25 12:25 AM;557058:d20b7121-5766-474b-aac2-87ddac585d67;[~accountid:60dc8744ee648800687b0348] We are checking with team and will update the ticket

column18:
05/Dec/25 3:34 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi [@arlan.ng|https://meltwater.slack.com/team/U027EM96RSQ],

* We reviewed the {{INSTANCE_IS_DELETED}} field in the {{DIM_INSTANCE}} table within {{GTM_PROCESSING_DB}}. This field originates from the dynamic table {{SALESFORCE_INSTANCE}} in {{GTM_STAGING_DB}}, which is built using the {{IS_DELETED}} field from the actual Salesforce source table {{MW_SOURCE_SS.SALESFORCE.INSTANCE_C}}.
* In Salesforce, the {{IS_DELETED}} field is set to *TRUE* only when a record is actually deleted.
* Since You are looking for the _soft delete_ flag, that is referring to the incorrect field. The filed  "*Is Company Deleted"*(IS_COMPANY_DELETED_C) flag needs to be added to the {{GTM_STAGING_DB.SALESFORCE.SALESFORCE_INSTANCE}} table. Once added at the staging level, it can then be properly propagated to the {{GTM_PROCESSING_DB.DIM_SALESFORCE.DIM_INSTANCE}} table for downstream reporting.

Let us know if you have any questions.

Thanks,
Mukesh

* The user manually updated the End Date at the Product Line Item (PLI) level during contract builder creation, which has resulted in a mismatch between the PLI End Date and the corresponding Entitlement End Date.

*In this example,* [https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000QbDQkIAN/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000QbDQkIAN/view]

*User followed below steps which caused End date mismatch*

* User selected *start date as April 23, 2025* and *subscription term as 10 months* in quote information section
* Then, user updated *end date as Jan 31, 2025 at PLI level*
* So, *End date is showing as Feb 22, 2025 at Entitlement level* and as *Jan 31, 2025 at PLI level*

*Current Logic:*
The Entitlement End Date is taking Order-level End Date.

*Conclusion:*
As per current system design, users can enter different Start and End Dates at the Product Line Item (PLI) level, independent of the dates specified at the Order level. Since Entitlements use the Order-level End Date.*This is working as designed.*

column1: Contract Upload Fails Due to Date Validation Error
column11:
*Hi Team,*

We got an [issue |https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04BB2E32M7/p1763069700644949]reported from *Almog Vernik*. 

We are encountering a repeated issue when attempting to upload a signed contract on the following opportunity:
[https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000W7DW1IAN/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000W7DW1IAN/view|smart-link] 

Each time we try to upload the external order confirmation, Salesforce throws the following error:

{{FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION: An order product's End Date can't be later than Order End Date.}}

!image-20251118-123431.png|width=666,alt="image-20251118-123431.png"!

h3. *Details:*

* The quote’s *End Date is set to Nov 30*, but the system keeps showing a validation error stating that a product line item (PLI) end date is greater than the quote end date.
* The *Forecast Contract End Date also keeps reverting back to Nov 29*, even after updates.
* The workaround shared earlier ({{Correct the dates so PLI end date ≤ Quote End Date}}) does *not* work in this case. The user adjusts the dates, but the error persists on upload.
* The user is asking if they need to *reopen a new opportunity from scratch*, but we would prefer to avoid that unless required.

h3. *Request:*

Please investigate why:

# The *PLI End Date validation continues to trigger*, even when the quote end date is correct.
# The *Forecast Contract End Date auto-reverts*.
# The *contract upload process fails consistently* for this opportunity.
# Confirm whether a *new opportunity creation* is required or if there is a fix to correct the underlying date sync issue.

Thank you!
column16:

column11:
Hello!

We have close to 200k accounts where the _Reporting Area (A)_ field is either blank or has an invalid value.  This is causing issues in our marketing reporting by area.

This is a formula field, so in order to trigger an update to these records, we need to update the *_Manual Update_* checkbox field.  This will automatically force the record to update, which will correct the values in the Reporting Area (A) field.

[This report|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Report/00ORf000002JWnpMAG/view?queryScope=userFolders] lists the exact accounts that need to be updated (18-digit Account ID included).  

# Please update the *_Manual Update_* field from *0* (false) to *1* (true).  
# After this update is complete, please revert this field back to *0* (false). _This is not absolutely necessary, but best for data hygiene/maintenance purposes._



Please let me know if you have any questions!

As we discussed on Slack:

----

h3. Issue#1:

Renewal opportunity [+Milence - - 2 - 2026+|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000MLWrkIAH/view]

*Existing order for this renewal opportunity* [+*00129083*+|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000Onzm5IAB/view]

Order Details:

* *Order Start Date:* March 1, 2025
* *Order End Date:* February 28, 2026
* *Approval Status:* Approved
* *Order Amount:* €14,500.00

If we review Order PLI level, there are 4 PLIs which have a start date  = 12/1/2025 and an End date = 2/28/26, which is for 3 months. Please see the screenshot below.

!image-20251118-072505.png|width=581,alt="image-20251118-072505.png"!

In Renewal Quote, all PLIs have start date  = Mar 1, 2026 and End date = Feb 28, 2027 (12 months)

!image-20251118-072613.png|width=581,alt="image-20251118-072613.png"!

Salesforce converted the Selling price from 3 months to 12 months for those 4 PLIs and then uplifted the amount by 5%.

Please see the calculation below.

|Product|SortProduct Code|Total Price|SortStart Date|SortEnd Date|Full year price for Renewal quote|5% uplift|
|Premium Support - Essential|FH-MWN406|EUR 3,425.00|45669|2/28/2026|13700|14385|
|AE Media Intelligence Essentials L2|FH-MWN364|EUR 2,700.00|45669|2/28/2026|10800|11340|
|Media Relations Platform|FH-MWN093|EUR 4,000.00 |45660|2/28/2026|4000|4200|
|Worldwide Influencer Database|FH-MWN095|EUR 1,500.00|45660|2/28/2026|1500|1575|
|Newsletter|FH-MWN004|EUR 775.00|45669|2/28/2026|3100|3255|
|AE Additional Searches|FH-MWN399|EUR 2,100.00 |45669|2/28/2026|8400|8820|
|*Total*| | | | | |*43575*|

*Conclusion*:

* Existing Annual Contract Value is correctly showing as 14500 as old order amount is 14500.
* ACV is calculated based on the current Quote, which is 4357,5 as we have confirmed per above calculation
* If you want to adjust the PLI pricing and contract duration, he can edit the order by using the *pricing* button.

h3. *Issue#2:*

Renewal opportunity  [+Milence - - 2 - 2026+|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000N0SttIAF/view]  is created for order [+*00384964*+|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000PaaVKIAZ/view]

*Order details:*

* *Order Start Date:* March 26, 2025
* *Order End Date:* February 28, 2026
* *Approval Status:* Approved
* *Order Amount:* €8,000.00

The renewal order start date is correctly generated as *March 1, 2026*, based on the existing order end date (*February 28, 2026*).
However, the renewal order end date should be *February 28, 2027* (one-year duration), but the system populated it as *March 25, 2027*.

h3. *Root Cause*

The incorrect renewal end date is caused by inaccurate start/end dates stored on the associated [+Contract+ |https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Contract/800Rf00000Ovx7FIAR/view]record. The contract was likely created shortly after CPQ go-live and contains data issues.

*Resolution:*

You can manually correct the Order and Price Line Item (PLI) end dates by selecting the *Pricing* button and updating the dates as needed.

!image-20251118-084425.png|width=581,alt="image-20251118-084425.png"!

h3. *Conclusion*

The renewal order end date is not automatically populated correctly due to legacy contract date inconsistencies. Manual adjustment is required until the contract data is corrected or automation logic is updated.

----

Please have a look and let us know if you have any questions.

Thanks,
Ayush

We have updated the logic behind updating the Renewal Manager on the Account Team:

* If the Renewal Manager is updated on the Account Team page, it will sync to the Account page.
* If the Renewal Manager is updated on the Account page, it will *not* sync back to the Account Team page.

* Reviewed account history *“Renewal Manager on Account Team”* field is not being tracked in the account history
* This field is a *lookup field*, and based on the current configuration, it is *not editable from the user interface* for standard users — only *System Administrators* have the permission to modify it.
* It seems that the data in this field was likely *updated through a bulk data operation*, such as via *Data Loader or another data import tool*, rather than through manual UI updates
* Searched corresponding *SFDC (Salesforce) ticket* related to this data upload activity, but *no records or tickets* were found documenting such an update
* Also executed a few test use cases in the *Kicksaw environment*, and observed that the *Renewal Manager* user is *consistent and matching in both places*.

BizApps Dev team is looking into this for further investigation.

column1: connect Gong with Salesforce
column11:
We have an issue reported by James Wanders that his Gong Dialler has disconnected from Salesforce.

I will provide the steps to connect Gong with Salesforce.

{quote}Original Request:
Hey team!
My gong dialler has disconnected from salesforce and I can no longer call from salesforce
I used to have a purple phone button next to a number and now I get a phone with a strike through it (pictured){quote}

!Screenshot 2025-11-12 at 10.55.25 am.png|width=394,alt="Screenshot 2025-11-12 at 10.55.25 am.png"!
column16:
12/Nov/25 5:40 AM;557058:6db0519c-1410-4686-ba76-a44b32d861c5;Hi [~accountid:712020:1ac6dc71-499c-46df-8f62-929fc944e7e7] ,

Here are the steps for connecting Gong to Salesforce:


# Login to Gong Application using your credentials:  [+https://app.gong.io+|https://app.gong.io/]  
!image-20250923-183432.png|width=550,alt="image-20250923-183432.png"!

# Account and Contacts should exist in Salesforce for recording Gong conversations. Click on the Home button at the top.

# Under the Calls section click on My Calls tab. Click on the Schedule button.
!image-20250923-182751.png|width=559,alt="image-20250923-182751.png"!

# Fill the call recording details(zoom meeting link or Google Meet link) and enter contact email under "Who was invited to the call? [Optional]" field.
!image-20250923-182530.png|width=585,alt="image-20250923-182530.png"!

# Open the conference link and admit the Gong attendee.

#  The meeting gets recorded. (At least the meeting should run for 3 minutes in order to record the Gong conversation). 

#  End the meeting for the Gong conversation to be processed. Once the recording is available it will be pushed to Salesforce. This will take a few minutes depending on the duration of the meeting.

#  In Salesforce click on the app launcher, search for [http://Gong.io|http://Gong.io|smart-link]  and open the [http://Gong.io|http://Gong.io|smart-link]  app to see the Gong Conversations.

!image-20250923-182454.png|width=601,alt="image-20250923-182454.png"!

 

# Open the Gong Conversation to view more details.
!image-20250923-182443.png|width=603,alt="image-20250923-182443.png"!

# Users can view the Gong Conversation logged as tasks under the Activity tab on the Account page.

Please let us know if you have any questions.

Regards,
Navya

column1: Integration issue: two Avalara fields need to be set to TRUE for US tax exempt orders
column11:
hi BizApps Integration team, hi [~accountid:557058:f80c1ab9-5e99-4953-95ba-1d7ccc943bdb] 

We’ve found that US Orders that are marked and approved as “*tax exempt*” in Salesforce, incorrectly come across to Netsuite *with* tax amount. 

This leads to incorrect Bookings & commissions on collections in SF for such cases, as the invoice object in SF pulls the total order amount incl. tax from Netsuite, instead of just the net order amount.

In order to fix this, the Netsuite team has identified that the following two fields need to be sent across as *True* from SF to NS in the Rest Webservices Request XML, which is sent over to create an approved Order in NS:



* Disable Avalara Tax Calculation (When set to True, it prevents NetSuite from sending the transaction to Avalara for tax determination.)
* Avalara Suspend Tax Call (When set to True, it temporarily halts Avalara tax calls—useful for manual overrides or when an order is intentionally exempt)

These fields are currently sent across as FALSE.



*Example from Sandbox:*

Tax exempt Order in SF Sandbox: [https://meltwater--kcksawfull.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Ek00001Y6mkEIAR/view|https://meltwater--kcksawfull.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Ek00001Y6mkEIAR/view]

Order in NS SB2 (showing tax): [https://3549017-sb2.app.netsuite.com/app/accounting/transactions/salesord.nl?id=37069162&whence=|https://3549017-sb2.app.netsuite.com/app/accounting/transactions/salesord.nl?id=37069162&whence=]

(screenshots attached from Sandboxes).



Here’s also the links to a similar *example from Production:*

Tax exempt Order in Production: [https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000a5cazIAA/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000a5cazIAA/view]

Order in NS (showing tax): [https://3549017.app.netsuite.com/app/accounting/transactions/salesord.nl?id=37017435&whence=|https://3549017.app.netsuite.com/app/accounting/transactions/salesord.nl?id=37017435&whence=]



Could you please help to ensure that when a US Order is marked as tax exempt upon approval in SF, that those two fields are set to TRUE in the Rest Webservices request sent to NS? 

Please let me know if you have any questions! Here’s the link to the NS ticket [https://meltwater.atlassian.net/browse/BSNA-506|https://meltwater.atlassian.net/browse/BSNA-506|smart-link]

column11:
Hello there,

Would it be possible to build a workflow for the Slack channel #cpq-insightsservices-feed that notifies us about new CPQ processes awaiting approval in the DelServ approvals section? Currently, we receive an email for every process waiting for approval, but there are simply too many of them, and as a result, many people have created rules that send them directly to the trash. The emails can certainly remain, but I’d like to have the same feed mirrored in the mentioned Slack channel.

In Slack, everyone could then set up their own alerts, filters, and preferences. I believe this would speed up response times to pending approvals and reduce the amount of communication from sales and renewal managers toward our team.

I think this should be quite easy one to do as we have many similar feeds to different channels from e.g. Jira.

column18:
05/Nov/25 3:20 PM;62f15545e50f2f2a39565bf5;Hi Anne,

The team checked, and the following was their analysis and conclusion.

*Analysis:*
The _Explore+-AddTenMillionDocuments_ (*explore-plus-doc-storage-limit-thousands*) entitlement correctly shows a total value of *22,000*, which matches the Account’s order.
Of this, *10,000* originates from the _Explore+-AddTenMillionDocuments_ bundle, and *12,000* comes from the _Explore+ Bronze_ bundle.

This entitlement is part of a bundle, and for bundled products, the *quantity is not transmitted from Salesforce to MI*, meaning the value is *not multiplied by 5*.

*Conclusion:*
_Explore+-AddTenMillionDocuments_ (*explore-plus-doc-storage-limit-thousands*) is a *bundle entitlement*, and its *quantity is not sent to MI*, hence the displayed value remains unmultiplied.

*This is a correct system behavior.*

Please review.

Regards,
Aviral Paliwal

The fact the multiplier is not taken into account on this *Add-on PLI* doesn’t seem logic at all to me as this PLI is not part of the bundle from a commercial stand point.

# Login to Gong Application using your credentials:  [https://app.gong.io|https://app.gong.io]

!image-20250923-182751.png|width=559,alt="image-20250923-182751.png"!

#  The meeting gets recorded. (At least the meeting should run for 3 minutes in order to record the Gong conversation). 

#  End the meeting for the Gong conversation to be processed. Once the recording is available it will be pushed to Salesforce. This will take a few minutes depending on the duration of the meeting.

#  In Salesforce click on the app launcher, search for [http://Gong.io|http://Gong.io|smart-link]  and open the [http://Gong.io|http://Gong.io|smart-link]  app to see the Gong Conversations.

24/Oct/25 12:13 AM;557058:6db0519c-1410-4686-ba76-a44b32d861c5;Hi [~accountid:5ebc092aed4a650b8e7c83d3] .

An email address is a required field when a rep creates a contact in Salesforce. The contact with a blank email address that you mentioned may have been created by the Integration User while using individual email, or vice versa. The team will investigate this further using the report you provided (by adding the 'Created By' column) and will keep you updated.

column18:
29/Oct/25 3:45 AM;557058:6db0519c-1410-4686-ba76-a44b32d861c5;Hi [~accountid:5ebc092aed4a650b8e7c83d3] ,

Team has looked into this and here are the findings:

* We found that the *Email* field is set as required only on the user interface. However, contacts can still be created without an email address through backend methods, such as Data Loader or other integrations.
* The report shows that contacts missing email addresses were created either by integrations or via the backend. It isn’t possible to create such records through the UI, as front-end validation prevents it.

Since the “required” check exists only at the UI level and not on the backend, contacts can still be created without an email address in certain cases.

column1: Error Encountered on Rebill Quotes with Negative Quantities
column11:
Peter Wolkow reported an [issue|https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04H6KBJE4S/p1760729196114069] where rebills with negative quantity quotes for PLIs that require a selection (such as Media Relations or Broadcast) are not saving entitlements, resulting in errors for reps.

The current workaround by SalesOps is to “closed/lost the rebill opportunity and then create a new one to "reset" it, since we cannot delete quote lines on a negative quantity.”

*Here are some of the examples for the above scenario but they have been fixed by SalesOps*:
[https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000TWjVyIAL/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000TWjVyIAL/view|smart-link] - this was closed

[https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000VGuKXIA1/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000VGuKXIA1/view|smart-link] - the negative Broadcast National PLI was not saving

Peter has suggested that “_If_ there is a way to make it so that negative quantities do not require entitlements at all, that would be ideal and amazing. because they shouldn't have to specify the country on a PLI that's just being canceled”

*Original Request:*

{quote}it looks like something is happening with rebills now where the _negative quantity_ on the Quote does not save the entitlements if it is a PLI that requires a selection (such as Media Relations or Broadcast). We've had at least three instances this week of the rep getting an error and we cannot save even after properly selecting and saving the entitlements.
The only fix has been to closed/lost the rebill opportunity and then create a new one to "reset" it, since we cannot delete quote lines on a negative quantity. Is this something you can look into please?

_If_ there is a way to make it so that negative quantities do not require entitlements at all, that would be ideal and amazing. because they shouldn't have to specify the country on a PLI that's just being canceled
{quote}

01/Nov/25 1:40 AM;557058:6db0519c-1410-4686-ba76-a44b32d861c5;Hi All,

Please find the impact analysis done by our team below:

h3. *Impact Analysis Summary*

*Scope:*
We analyzed downstream impacts related to *Lead*, *Contact*, and *Account* merge processes.

----

h4. *Lead Merge*

* *Impact:* No downstream impact observed.
* *Reason:* Lead data is not integrated with any external systems.

----

h4. *Contact Merge*

* *Impacts Observed:*
** *NetSuite Integration:*
*** The deleted (merged) Contact record remains in NetSuite.
*** There is currently no mechanism to remove Contacts from NetSuite when deleted in Salesforce.
** *Totango Integration:*
*** The deleted (merged) Contact record persists in Totango.
*** There is no process to remove Contacts from Totango upon deletion in Salesforce.
* *No Impact Observed:* MI Integration, Warpzone Integration, and CRM Services.

----

h4. *Account Merge*

* *Impacts Observed:*
** *NetSuite Integration:*
*** Orders linked to deleted Accounts are correctly reassigned to the Parent Account in Salesforce.
*** However, this change is *not reflected in NetSuite*, as there is no update process for approved orders.
** *MI Integration:*
*** customerId is not updated in MI App for MI Company which is moved from deleted account
*** Entitlements are not updated based on active order if active orders are moved from deleted account.
* *No Impact Observed:* Warpzone, Totango, and CRM Web Services.

----

h4. *Conclusion*

Merging *Contacts* and *Accounts* can cause data inconsistencies across downstream systems, as deletions in Salesforce are not properly reflected in integrated applications.

 CC [~accountid:623c09c6a9575800695ac88d] [~accountid:5dea7c32b95b180d17cfca03] , Please review.

Regards,
Navya

column19:
01/Oct/25 2:44 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Anni,

Below are the investigation details:

*Investigation*

# *Renewal Opportunity*
#* [+View Renewal Opportunity+|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000QbnPPIAZ/view]
#* _Existing Contract End Date:_ *10/29/2025*
# *Renewed Contract*
#* [+View Renewed Contract+|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Contract/800Rf00000SLvKzIAL/view]
#* *Contract Start Date:* 7/30/2025
#* *Contract Term:* 3 months
#* *Calculated Contract End Date:* 7/30/2025 + 3 months → *10/29/2025*
# *Logic*
#* Per implementation, The _Existing Contract End Date_ on the renewal opportunity is automatically copied from the _Contract End Date_ on the renewed contract.
#* Since the contract end date is *10/29/2025*, the renewal opportunity correctly reflects the same date.
# *Order End Date Discrepancy*
#* [+View Order+|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000U6HrLIAV/view]  → This is a renewal order
#* _Order End Date:_ *9/30/2025*
#* This does not match with the contract end date (*10/29/2025*).
# *Behavior Difference: NewBiz vs Renewal*
#* *NewBiz Opportunities:*
#** _Order End Date_ is automatically calculated as _Contract Start Date + Contract Term (months)_
#* *Renewal Opportunities:*
#** _Order End Date_ is selectable

----

*Conclusion:*

* _As per implementation, Contract End Date_ is correctly copied to the renewal opportunity.
* *This issue comes when renewal opportunity is created when a renewal order is approved and order end date is not in format* *_Contract Start Date + Contract Term (months)_*

----

*Workaround:*

* Update the _Existing Contract End Date_ on the renewal opportunity

Let me know if you have any questions.

Thanks,
Mukesh

column1: Determine what populates Existing ACV and how to make it accurate.
column11:
We have a request from Dale Jones to determine what populates the Existing ACV field on the opportunity and how we can ensure its accuracy.

*Original Request:*

{quote}“Can you add to the list of things to figure out what is populating this field and how we can get it accurate for me w/ Suchitra?”{quote}

*Note:* This was discussed in slack group chat
column16:
18/Sep/25 4:09 AM;5ebc08ec9756e40b84c9fd40;[~accountid:5dea7c32b95b180d17cfca03]  Below is the logic for the Existing Annual Contact field on the Renewal Opportunity:

The existing Annual contract value is sum of all active subscription (From all PLI) in the renewed contract (on the Renewal opportunity)
column17:
26/Sep/25 3:15 AM;5ebc08ec9756e40b84c9fd40;Hi [~accountid:5dea7c32b95b180d17cfca03] [~accountid:63d7fa6ac2b1cb6b346f5749] 

Based on the above reported problem our understanding is in some cases the Existing ACV field on the Renewal opportunity doesn’t show correct value and the request from [~accountid:5dea7c32b95b180d17cfca03] was to investigate how the ‘Existing ACV’ is populated. we investigated and found that on Renewal opp the existing contract value is the sum of all subcription lines of the contract(from the renewed opp).

Example :  [https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000OmzL7IAJ/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000OmzL7IAJ/view|smart-link] 

Existing Annual Contract Value= GBP 12,750.00 (USD 17,251.51)

Logic for Existing Annual contract value on Renewal Opp:

# Existing ACV on Renewal Opp = ACV on the renewed contract that exists on the original opp that triggered the renewal opp.
# Acv on contract = Sum of ACV of all subscription lines.
## Now the ACV on Subscription object is always annualized regardless of the subscription term (Formula Below). This sums to the contract —> Existing annual contract value (Renewal Opp)
# ACV on Renewal Opp 
## ACV is only annualized if term is >= 12 months

*Subscription Object:.*

12* SBQQ__Quantity__c *

IF(

ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Product__r.Quantity_Based_Pricing__c, "Extend price"),

(SBQQ__NetPrice__c / Contract_Term__c),

((SBQQ__NetPrice__c / SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c) /

IF(

ISBLANK(SBQQ__Product__r.SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c),

12,

SBQQ__Product__r.SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c

))

)

*Observation:*

# There is difference in calculation logic for ACV in subscription object vs the Opportunity. (In subscription object ACV is always annulaized where as in Opportunity the ACV is annualized if term >=12)
# The formula for ACV on Subscription object need to align with ACV on on Renewal Opp so both values match.

column1: Investigation | Missing Upsell Option after sales stage status change
column11:
We have an issue reported by Cameran Testerman. The [Opportunity|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000BIEeUIAX/view] was mistakenly moved to _Closed/Consolidated_ by sales but has been reverted to _Closed/Won_ for an upsell. Now, the opportunity amount ($19,414.50) doesn’t match the [order|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000MsksVIAR/view] amount ($15,385 — correct amount), and the upsell option is no longer available.

{quote}Dennis and I were looking at [this opp|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000BIEeUIAX/view] that the sales team had accidently moved to closed/consolidated, which was a mistake by them. Dennis and I were able to move it back to closed/won as they are trying to upsell on the opp, and it should coincide with [this order|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000MsksVIAR/view].However, now the amounts between the opp and the order do not match. The opp says $19414.50, but the order says $15385 which is the correct amount.Additionally after moving to closed/won, it is not showing the option to upsell off of this opp. Is there anything we are missing when we are looking at this? Any guidance would be much appreciated, thank you!{quote}
column16:
15/Aug/25 9:02 PM;557058:6db0519c-1410-4686-ba76-a44b32d861c5;Jarek and I have updated Cameran with the below details:

We recently found that there is some impact when the Opportunity Sales Stage is updated from Closed Lost to Closed Won. The Close Date, Commissions ACV  and Credit Records needs to be reviewed.

* Closed Date: The impact for Closed Date is that it will be updated to the date  that you changed the Sales Stage
* Impact Date: This is auto calculated based on the Closed Date.
* Comm ACV: Comm ACV is populated, but accuracy is uncertain
* Credit Record ID: A Commission Credit record without amount will be generated and this record might need to be deleted.

Cameran would like to understand why he’s unable to perform an upsell on the Opportunity marked as Closed Won.
column17:
15/Aug/25 9:03 PM;557058:6db0519c-1410-4686-ba76-a44b32d861c5;Hi Cameran,

The team investigated and found that the Upsell will only be available once an order is created and approved for the opportunity. Since no order has been created for this opportunity yet, the *Upsell* button is not displayed.

Regards,
Navya
