Dear Data Privacy Officer,



I am writing to demand that you immediately cease and desist any unauthorized collection, processing, sale, sharing, or retention of my personal data, including but not limited to my name, email address, physical address, phone number, and any other identifying information.



As a California resident, I am protected under multiple robust privacy laws, including but not limited to the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), California Civil Code, and the California Constitution. These laws provide me with specific rights concerning how my personal data is acquired, used, shared, and retained.



I. YOUR OBLIGATIONS UNDER CALIFORNIA LAW

Under the CCPA/CPRA and related statutes, you must:



Disclose and honor opt-out requests regarding the sale or sharing of my personal data (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.120, § 1798.135).



Provide full transparency regarding the categories and specific pieces of personal information collected, sources of collection, purposes for data use, and all third parties with whom my data has been shared (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.100).



Limit the use of my personal data to the purposes for which it was collected and prevent unauthorized or unlawful sale, sharing, or transfer to third parties (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.115).



Secure and protect my data from unauthorized access and breaches through reasonable security measures (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.81.5).



Permanently delete my personal information upon request unless you are legally required to retain it (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.105).



Refrain from retaliating against me for exercising my privacy rights (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.125).



II. VIOLATIONS AND DAMAGES

Your failure to comply with these obligations constitutes:



Unlawful business practices under the California Business and Professions Code § 17200.



Violations of my constitutional right to privacy under Article 1, Section 1 of the California Constitution.



Statutory violations entitling me to damages as follows:



California Civil Code § 1798.150: Statutory damages of $100 to $750 per violation per incident, or actual damages, whichever is greater.



California Civil Code § 1798.155: Civil penalties of up to $2,500 per violation, or up to $7,500 for each intentional violation.



Exposure of my personal data to undisclosed third parties without my explicit consent, which breaches my right to control my personal information.



III. DEMAND FOR ACTION AND COMPENSATION

In light of the above, you are hereby ordered to:



Immediately cease all collection, sale, transfer, sharing, or other use of my personal data not explicitly authorized by law.



Provide full disclosure within 14 calendar days detailing:



The sources from which you acquired my data.



The categories and specific data points collected.



All third parties and recipients with whom my data has been shared or sold, including dates.



The business purposes for which my data has been used.



Permanently delete all personal data related to me from all your records, databases, and third-party partners.



Acknowledge in writing your violation of my privacy rights under California law.



Remit compensation of $3,000, representing a conservative statutory damages amount for multiple violations of the CCPA/CPRA and related laws.



Send payment via certified check or money order to:



Jessie Rucker

458 Williams Street

Murphys, CA 95247



Payment and disclosures must be received within 30 calendar days from the date of this letter.



IV. CONSEQUENCES OF NON-COMPLIANCE

Failure to comply will compel me to:



File formal complaints with the California Privacy Protection Agency and California Attorney General.



Initiate civil litigation seeking the maximum damages and penalties permitted under California law.



Notify federal regulatory agencies and consumer protection organizations.



V. NO FURTHER COMMUNICATION

Except to confirm data deletion and arrange payment, do not contact me further. Any unsolicited communication will be documented and may be used in legal proceedings.



VI. REQUEST FOR PROOF OF COMPLIANCE

If you have already complied with all applicable California privacy laws, you must provide detailed, verifiable documentation within 30 days proving your compliance.



I expect your immediate and full cooperation to uphold my rights under California law.



Sincerely,

Jessie Rucker

Separately, are you able to check whether the {{dow-jones-factiva-full}} entitlement is unaffected by automated entitlement triggers?

If I enable it manually, will it be automatically disabled later?{quote}

column18:
06/Aug/25 3:45 PM;5f3a8eca42959b00397651e9;Hi Yasira,

Thanks for your patience. Please find the responses of your question as below:

|{quote}*_We're trying to understand how entitlements behave when linked to multiple PLIs within the same order - specifically in a volume-based scenario._*

*_Let's say the same entitlement is tied to two different PLIs, both included in the order. Is it possible for one PLI to override or take precedence over the other, based on the volume specified?_*{quote}
As per the current implementation of entitlement sync from the CRM to MI
* When the same entitlements are available in separate active Order of an Account, the entitlements are summed up while syncing to MI platform
* For example, Contract-A has 5 Searches entitlement and Contract-B has 10 Searches entitlement then upon entitlement sync from CRM to MI, the summed value i.e. 5+10=15 will be enforced in MI platform|
|{quote}*_This question has come up in relation to Dow Jones. We'll soon have a PLI that specifies a fixed number of Dow Jones newsletter recipients. That number should override the recipient count from the Meltwater Newsletter PLI - even if the Meltwater one includes a higher volume._*

*_In other words, the number of newsletter recipients from the Dow Jones PLI should represent the total allowed, regardless of what's specified in the Meltwater NL PLI._*{quote}
As per the current implementation of entitlement sync from the CRM to MI,
* There is no logic for precedence of PLIs
* The common entitlements from separate PLIs will be summed up for limit/numeric entitlements like Number of X (searches, users, Newsletters etc)
* Hence if a Contract or multiple Active contracts of an Account have same entitlement irrespective of they are associated to Meltwater Newsletter PLI or Dow Jones Newsletter PLI the count will be summed up.
* In case of toggle entitlements (like newsletterEnabled) that has true or false value, then if any of the PLI of the active Contract has a true value for the entitlement then the true value is sent to MI.|
|{quote}*_Separately, are you able to check whether the dow-jones-factiva-full entitlement is unaffected by automated entitlement triggers?_*
*_We want to confirm if this entitlement will remain active even when there's no linked PLI - or will the system automatically turn it off during the next entitlement refresh?_*{quote}
* In our understanding there is no special treatment in the CRM for entitlements of Dow Jones PLIs.
* Hence, the automated entitlement sync trigger will update or reset the entitlement value in MI as per the active Orders in the CRM.|
|{quote}*_If I enable it manually, will it be automatically disabled later?_*{quote}
* Yes this is correct.
* If an entitlement is manually added for a company in the MI platform, it will be removed/rest on next entitlement sync from the CRM due to an Order level trigger.|

Please have a look and let us know if you need any other assistance.

Regards,
Ayush

column18:
31/Jul/25 12:27 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Patty,

* “Allow Login” flag only updates when the sales stage of the opportunity is updated to Closed Won/Lost.
* If we remove the “Client Opportunity” flag on Opportunity, then it will update the “MI Company Lifecycle Status” field to “Prospect” on MI Company. And the Allow Login Flag will not update on MI Company.

column11:
We have an [issue|https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C08R478NV7F/p1753467870601139] reported by Cody Crawford on #tmp_wirecredits_fix. I am creating this ticket on behalf of Cody

{quote}Making sure that full-service wire orders activate the Newswire tab in the platform? Every time we have a renewal for full-service orders it deactivates the wires tab, which is needed to add the wire account to their platform. 28/Aug/25 10:26 PM;557058:6db0519c-1410-4686-ba76-a44b32d861c5;Hi [~accountid:6271716ba1de4100684f904d] ,

Based on the investigation for above request and discussions with SalesOps (Hanna, Claudia, Peter, Yaribel) and Product Owner (Jonathon Barbee) here is the latest update:
Jonathon:
Full service wires have never had associated entitlements. We've just manually turned them on when a customer needs to add a newswire company.
MI Support has a workaround for this use case.
Since the mentioned Full service Newswire PLIs do not have an associated entitlement, the Newswire tab does not show in MI platform. The current system behavior is working as designed.
There is an existing validation in MI platform that Newswire tab will show for respective company only when there is a Newswire entitlement provisioned for the company.
For any question or concern with these set of Newswire PLIs, user can connect with SalesOps and/or PO (Jonathon Barbee).

Regards,
Navya

column1: MI Company stuck on wrong rebill opp – ANZ Bank
column11:
We have an [issue|https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04BB2E32M7/p1753325365888029] reported by Carmen Chan in #salesforce-go-live, where the MI Company is not correctly associated.

Currently:

* The MI Company "[Australia and New Zealand Banking Group (ANZ Bank)|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Instance__c/a0HRf000001z7iLMAQ/view]" is tied to an [Amendment for contract #00037847|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000O7DtzIAF/view], which is believed to be a dead duplicate.
* Multiple rebill attempts seem to have occurred, and the MI Company appears to be incorrectly tied to the wrong rebill due to a past MI move workflow.

It is unclear where the MI Company was originally tied. It's suspected that it was from the original NewBiz Opp: "[Australia and New Zealand Banking Group (ANZ Bank) - Corporate Communications Pilot [B]|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf00000JYEaOIAX/view]", which is now marked as Closed Lost / Rebilled, but still has MI Company Lifecycle = Customer because the active order is tied to it.

*Main Questions for Investigation:*

# Did the rebill happen?
# If yes, then:
#* The MI Company and order should have moved to the rebill opportunity.
#* The rebill opportunity type should be New Business, not Upsell.
# If not, then:
#* The original NewBiz opportunity should not be marked Closed Lost / Rebilled.
#* The MI Company should still be associated with the original opportunity.

Please investigate the MI move history and rebill flow logic to confirm what went wrong.
column16:
25/Jul/25 3:23 AM;557058:6db0519c-1410-4686-ba76-a44b32d861c5;Team did an investigation and here are the details:

If not, then:
* The original NewBiz opportunity should not be marked Closed Lost / Rebilled. *→  When the associated order is cancelled through NetSuite as a credit memo created, the original new business opportunity stage is marked as Closed Lost / Rebill. Credit memo in NetSuite is created by SalesOps.*
* The MI Company should still be associated with the original opportunity - *initially, multiple rebill opportunities were allowed, but this was stopped around mid-May. Also, now MI is associated with the Rebill opportunity when the rebill order is approved. So this issue is fixed now.*

column1: Users added on Salesforce get visibility in app disabled (isShown = False)
column11:
*Summary*:

There seems to be some problems with our current adding users flow from Salesforce to MI. When Product Support and on-boarding teams are adding external users via Salesforce you are unable to see those users in the “Manage Users” list in MI. The users are present on the account and in Salesforce but if you try to find them in the user list on the account they are not visible in the list, (isShown = False on the user object). Also, if you then try to add the user via the front-end you'll get an error “This user already exists”. 

Here is the logic in place from Salesforce to the App Framework teams when creating users:

When creating an MI user for an MI Company from Salesforce, we determine whether the user already exists in the MI platform based on their email address.

# If the user *does not exist*, we always create a new user in MI with {{isShown = True}}.
# If the user already exists on a different MI Company, we update their company membership on the current MI Company using the existing MI User ID and set {{isShown = False}}.

Their reasoning was: If created via the app, users will always show in the user list. If added via SFDC, they get visibility set to false, as this was intended to be used for internal meltwater users accessing multiple opportunities. Our Support Org is hoping we can change this flow, to allow on-boarding external users via Salesforce to be more seamless and they will show in the account. 

Related Support ticket: [https://meltwater.atlassian.net/browse/TRITON-29679|https://meltwater.atlassian.net/browse/TRITON-29679]

This ticket stems from this conversation: [https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04H72LJQ9L/p1751052318140949|https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04H72LJQ9L/p1751052318140949|smart-link]  


I had been bounced around on ownership on this and then the team stated there was no real bug here but rather a process issue so I’m hoping this ticket can help start the conversation around improving this flow. Feel free to reach out if you have further questions! Thanks

We found that all these users belong to multiple MI Companies. Below is the logic that has been in place since the beginning. When creating an MI user for an MI Company from Salesforce, we determine whether the user already exists in the MI platform based on their email address.

# If the user *does not exist*, we always create a new user in MI with isShown = True.
# If the user already exists on a different MI Company, we update their company membership on the current MI Company using the existing MI User ID and set isShown = False.

Cody Perry also confirmed the *below. This is not a bug & it is working as designed*:
*"I think the recommendation here is to create external users (i.e. customer users) via the application and not SFDC, especially if they are going to be on more than 1 company. If created via the app, users will always show in the user list. This logic from SFDC seems to be working as expected and there’s been no changes to the behavior on our end to consider it a bug."*

As we discussed on Slack, here is the current workflow outlined below:

column1: Super Admin Sunset | Christiane questions about QS/QC & CC data in Super Admin
column11:
Following Super Admin Sunset email from Suchitra, *Christiane Graetke-Schreiber* (Director of Finance) replied with question:

{quote}Is there a way to retain the order page in SuperAdmin that shows the allocated QC, CC / QS for the reps and the invoice issued / schedule and the corresponding payments?

Currently we are working through audit questions for commissions paid in 2020-2022.

It will be hard to show prove of contract, allocated QS or QC and invoices & payments when Super Admin is completely gone.

Given that Audits – also local statutory Audits – are that much behind we still need to be able to pull the info.

If maintaining a hard copy of the order page is not an option, could you please let me know: 

* Which period of Quota Sales / QC & CC has been synced to SFDC? Has someone audited the sync to ensure both systems show the same amounts?
* Is there a way to search in SF by the older SuperAdmin order ID? I know they show in on the order page but if I search for the old SA-Order ID it does not find the order.
* When will the invoice to payment allocation in SFDC be updated to show correct payments against all old invoices for audit questions?
* Is it possible to create a Tableau workbook by SA Order ID with all the above info that is currently on the order page in SuperAdmin?

Same questions as above arise on MRR quota pages. 

I know the goal is to sunset SuperAdmin asap, but from an Audit perspective we need to be able to trace at least the last 4 years of QS / QC&CC data.{quote}

She followed up with:

{quote}Is there a way to keep the order page in SuperAdmin for Audit requests?

All commission expense is booked following ASC 606 over the client life-time – i.e. a 4-year basis. Thus, auditors are now checking 2020-2024 deals. 

Next year they might ask for 2021-2025. We need to have a way to see which QS were allocated to deals, when the invoice was raised and paid to justify the commission expense.

I’m worried that will not be possible without a static Order page view from SuperAdmin.{quote}

Team will have a meeting with SalesOps to discuss these questions from Christiane. Also, team will have a meeting with Christiane to discuss about this.

column1: My team rely on Superadmin to find Account Manager's in the scope of their customer's tickets
column11:
Hello, 

Writing this on behalf of the Media Research organisation. We are concerned that losing access to Superadmin will render us unable to properly support customer In App requests pertaining to Contacts within Media Relations. It seems highly likely that we need access to Salesforce in order to find the right people to contact in relation to their customer’s requests. 

Today we use Superadmin to:

# Search opportunities in order to find the Company that has initiated an In App support request in Media Relations. Discover who is the Account Manager who owns that account in order to inform or to gain their help in regards to their customer who has made requests.
# Check the contract of that customer in order to establish which country databases they have actually purchased. 
# Retrieve ‘customer segment’ which informs the queue system we have in place in Jira to manage all In App requests. 

Number 1 is irreplaceable and we see no workaround for it without access to the new CRM, unless you can help to provide a workaround? Number 2 we can workaround this ourselves by referring to the Support Admin Tool (entitlements per account listed within that). And number 3 we understand that Blake Corman is already committed to ensuring this ability to assign customer segment to In App tickets is not disrupted. So we’re looking here for your help understanding how to go about 1. 

Thanks and best, Michael on behalf of Media Research org (consisting of 16 people including myself)

*Investigation Summary:*

* For this particular [Order|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000Tx3E5IAJ/related/OrderItems/view?ws=%2Flightning%2Fr%2FOrder%2F801Rf00000Tx3E5IAJ%2Fview] → Details → [Order Products|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000Tx3E5IAJ/related/OrderItems/view], while doing the rebill, the rep has clubbed the total price of 2 PLI’s into 1.

* We found that when the total pricing is being clubbed together, then there is mismatch for total price for rebill PLIs. Because of this, Salesforce is incorrectly sending the negative quantity for the PLI to Netsuite. 

*Recommendation:* 

* The recommendation for preventing this issue from happening is the Rep should input the correct total price for each PLI separately. 
* Additionally, Deal Desk will need to review PLI total amount, total quantity before approving the order.

column1: Dependencies for Account Level Products
column11:
Hey team,

I was asked by Courtney and Ed to submit this so we can work on flagging it to SCG as a potential fix that they can action. Here is the background:

We had product rules set up for "dependencies" i.e. certain products are add-ons and can only be sold if the customer already has the "parent" product associated with it. This was set up by Kicksaw as Error Conditions tied to Summary Variables, which look at Quote Lines. It all works fine for cases where the parent and child products are both on the same quote or opportunity, or (I believe) even if an amendment from the approved opportunity, as it reads the original product on the quote line.

The issue is that that wasn't good enough and we need the error condition to look at *all of the subscriptions on the account*, so if a customer has the parent product on a different opportunity, and we create a new opportunity to sell the "child product", it still reads that they have it even though it's not on the same opportunity. Essentially: make those error conditions look at all products on the entire account, not just the one opportunity.

I was offered a solution to this by Kicksaw, that solution being to clone the error conditions and summary variables and make them apply to the subscription as well. I ran these in bulk for just [one example in Sandbox|https://meltwater--kcksawfull.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/SBQQ__ProductRule__c/a2URf000000PGT5MAO/related/SBQQ__ErrorConditions__r/view] (the Worldwide Media Database add on), and everything was done correctly. But in testing it, the dependency flag still came up when it should not (new upsale opp with a "parent" subscription already approved).

I dug into that further, looking for an explanation on ChatGPT and got the explanation that basically adding a subscription error condition doesn't do what we want afterall, and pretty much is redundant if the Quote Line ones are already in place. Can we ask SCG if there is some other way of making this work?

Thanks!

Here are the details for the *current implementation*:

* The *Billing Schedule* is sent as *100% Upfront* from Salesforce to NetSuite *only if* the formula field {{Order.Upfront_Billing__c}} is {{TRUE}}.
* If {{Order.Upfront_Billing__c}} is {{FALSE}}, the Billing Schedule is sent as *Custom*.

h3. {{Order.Upfront_Billing__c}} Formula:

{noformat}IF(
AND(
ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__BillingFrequency__c, 'Upfront'),
IF(
ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Quote__r.Billing_Start_Date_Setting__c,"Signature Date"),
SBQQ__Quote__r.Adobe_Agreement_Signed_Date__c,
SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__StartDate__c
) <= TODAY()
),
TRUE,
FALSE){noformat}

This means:

* *Upfront Billing* is applied only if:
** *Billing Frequency* = _"Upfront"_, and
** The relevant *start date* (based on the picklist setting) is *today or earlier*

column17:
12/Jun/25 11:45 AM;62f15545e50f2f2a39565bf5;Hi Marlon,

Thank you for reaching out. The links you've shared are classic Salesforce record URLs, which are being accessed through the Lightning interface using the {{_classic}} path. These typically point to *Opportunities*, as denoted by the record prefix {{006}}, which is standard for Opportunity records in Salesforce.

* *What are these links?*
These are links to *Opportunity records*, just displayed using the classic URL format ({{/_classic/<recordId>}}), but still accessible in Lightning Experience.
* *How are they generated?*
These links are usually generated when:
** A user manually copies the URL while viewing the record in *Salesforce Classic* (or through a fallback to Classic).
** Certain automations, email templates, or legacy systems still generate classic-style links.
** A user switches to Classic view for a specific session or action.
* *Is this a user setting?*
Not specifically. It’s not a permanent user setting, but rather based on how the link was obtained or generated. Some users might be temporarily redirected to Classic due to permissions, feature limitations, or specific record behaviors.

Please let us know if you have any questions.

Regards,
Aviral Paliwal

column19:
12/Jun/25 5:37 PM;62f15545e50f2f2a39565bf5;Hi Marlon,

Here are a few commonly used Salesforce record prefixes (which may appear in both Classic and Lightning URLs):

* *001* – Account
* *003* – Contact
* *005* – User
* *00Q* – Lead
* *00T* – Task
* *00U* – Event
* *a0H* – Instance

As for the {{/lightning/_classic/}} path — it's essentially a *Lightning wrapper for Classic page redirection*. So URLs like:

{{https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/_classic/%2F0065f00000IrdYMAAZ }}

…are just Lightning redirecting to a Classic page view of the Opportunity {{0065f00000IrdYMAAZ}}. These still follow the record prefix pattern and can be handled by decoding the {{recordId}} segment ({{%2F}} = {{/}}).

To strengthen your handling logic, you might also watch for:

* {{/lightning/r/<ObjectName>/<recordId>}} — standard Lightning format
* {{/lightning/_classic/%2F<recordId>}} — Classic redirection in Lightning
* Direct Classic format: {{/0065f00000IrdYMAAZ}} (not wrapped in {{/lightning}} at all)

Let me know if you'd like a fuller list of prefixes or object mappings — happy to help support your process further.

Regards,
Aviral Paliwal

column1: Request for $0 API Setup for Panasonic Reporting Use Case
column11:
Dear Business Applications Service Desk team,

I was referred to your team by Christopher Matthee regarding an API capacity issue we are currently facing with one of our reporting use cases.

*Background Summary:*
Our team at Client Insight Japan has been running a weekly reporting task for Panasonic using Export Console. This task involves downloading data from approximately 360 queries each week via the shared API account ([api.delivery.japan@meltwater.com|mailto:api.delivery.japan@meltwater.com]).

However, we’ve been encountering the following challenges:

* When download history from other reports accumulates, the Panasonic queries are pushed out and automatically deleted due to system constraints.
* As a result, the automated download setup stops working, leading to significant manual intervention to restore the settings.
* Additionally, recurring reports for other clients are affected as they require manual reconfiguration once previous APIs are purged.

*Request:*
Based on Christopher’s suggestion, we would like to request the setup of a *$0 API account dedicated to Panasonic*, which would ensure:

* A separate PLI/API specific to Panasonic
* Stability and continuity of the automated reporting process without being impacted by other report cases using the same account

We believe this setup would reduce operational burden and ensure a more sustainable workflow.

Please let us know the steps required to proceed with this request, or if you need any further details.

Thank you very much for your support.

Best regards,

 Atsushi

column1: Bringing Support Data Into Snowflake DB
column11:
Hello, I’ve been working with RevOps (Marvel initiative) and there is an urgent need to bring product support ticket data (originating from Jira for MWTR and TRITON projects) into the SnowFlake DB for RevOps to consume. We understand that there was a recent attempt to use FiveTran for the import - but the amount of data changes exceeded our credit allowances when attempting to bring in the MWTR and TRITON projects and so it has been discontinued.

We want to help get the ticket data loaded into SnowFlake. We already load this ticket data into an AWS RDS MySQL DB via python scripts. Our data is made available in Tableau Cloud. RevOps would prefer to not join in Tableau - citing slow performance as a concern - and so they’d like the data brought directly into SnowFlake (alongside SalesForce data). One option is to use a tableau data adapter to bring ticket data into SnowFlake.

The above is priority - the following is more long term but may impact how we move forward… As our use of Snowflake expands beyond RevOps, we'd like to establish a more structured and scalable approach to support additional teams like Support and Engineering using this DB.

Currently, RevOps is using Snowflake for transforming data into dynamic table views for reporting. To enable other teams to do the same while maintaining clarity and appropriate access controls, we’d like to request the following:

(Names are just for example, final names are TBD)



# *Create Team-Specific Schemas* within our existing Snowflake database:
#* {{REVOPS_SCHEMA}} (or whatever it currently is)
#* {{SUPPORT_SCHEMA}} - MWTR ticket data analysis + other support data feeds (stella, kantata, intercom)
#* {{ENGINEERING_SCHEMA}} - TRITON ticket data analysis + other ENG data feeds
# *Set Up Corresponding Roles* with appropriate permissions:
#* {{REVOPS_ROLE}} – access to {{REVOPS_SCHEMA}}(or whatever it is today)
#* {{SUPPORT_ROLE}} – access to {{SUPPORT_SCHEMA}}
#* {{ENGINEERING_ROLE}} – access to {{ENGINEERING_SCHEMA}}

This will allow each team to work within their own space while maintaining data governance and clarity of ownership.

We can mirror the approach in place by RevOps for transforming data.

column1: Updating the automation of converted lead ownership
column11:
Hi Team, 

I could use some help in adjusting/updating a currently existing automation that happens when a lead gets converted to a contact. 

Basically the automation is that when someone owns a lead, then converts it onto an account/opp, the contact owner becomes the account owner, and not the person that was the lead owner upon conversion (in case those are different).
As people can be working and owning contacts on accounts they do not own, it would be great to update this logic so that the contact owner is the person that owned the lead upon conversion. 

Business case for doing this is because we cannot continue with building an automation in LD / UserGems until this has been updated. 

For demonstration purposes I will walk you in more detail through the current state and requested future state. Let's say I own the lead, and you own the account I want to convert the lead onto into a contact.

* Current Situation:
** I am currently technically able to convert this lead onto the account owned by someone else
** But immediately upon conversion, you as the account owner become the owner of the newly created contact
* Future Situation:
** I am still able to convert a lead I own onto an account I do not own
** Upon conversion, the newly created contact ownership remains the same from the lead ownership.
** And you as the account owner also remain account owner.
** So I am contact owner because I owned the lead I converted and you still account owner as you owned it prior to my lead conversion. 

This update request has been approved by Robin Blampied. 

Let me know if you have any questions. And thanks in advance for your support here!



Best, 

Abigail

This causes some issues as we have employees that support regions different than where they live. E.g. Pauline Bodart lives in America and rolls up to America superarea based on location hierarchy but her sales office is in EMEA and she works on EMEA business- her super area is EMEA based on the sales office hierarchy in WD. Same goes for Katharina Kirsch (see screenshot for examples where blue circle is the field we currently pull in to SFDC and red circle is the field that is more accurate for our sales org).

Is it possible to link the Superarea field from the sales office hierarchy in WD instead? It would be a more accurate representation for our salesforce.

01/Jan/25 1:09 AM;557058:bf99b747-df06-4f96-a03b-0a42637bf91a;Hi [~accountid:557058:6db0519c-1410-4686-ba76-a44b32d861c5] , sorry for the late reply - I missed the update here.

We understand that SnowFlake data is updated multiple times per day and, although it is not real-time, it is near real-time. (I think I heard it is updated every 6-12 hours). That level of update would be sufficient for most of what we need (this particular request use case). It would also allow for us to “self-help” in situations where we quickly need data from the system.

For this reason we would very much like to have the access to SnowFlakeDB for SalesForce Data.

NOTE: We’re past mid-December. I really think the BASD team is overloaded with requests and I think that giving us access to this data directly would be the quickest way to resolve this as well as future requests.

column21:
15/Jan/25 2:27 AM;557058:bf99b747-df06-4f96-a03b-0a42637bf91a;Hi [~accountid:557058:6db0519c-1410-4686-ba76-a44b32d861c5] and [~accountid:557058:d20b7121-5766-474b-aac2-87ddac585d67] , Thanks for meeting with me and Christina today. Here is a list of reasons why we need access to the SFDC SnowFlake DB.

* We have a Support Data Warehouse which would greatly benefit from SFDC data sets. Basically, all the same reasons that the Product Analysis team (i.e. Patty Boskin’s team) have access in order to build an Product Analysis Data Warehouse are our reasons for needing access.
* Near real-time is good enough (up to 1-day lag is ok).
* Specific Data Sets:
** Sales Account Segment Structure - list of account hierarchy along with segmentation - to provide aggregate analysis of tickets per account segment.
** Sales Account Roles Structure - list of roles (CSM, owner, etc) per account/opportunity - to provide aggregate analysis of tickets per role. NOTE: We currently get this information from Totango’s API - but are limited to only retrieving a few thousand at a time. We would prefer to get the information more direct from the source.
** Identification of Recently Churned Accounts - allow support to build a process for resolving tickets for customers that have churned so that we do not reach out to them after they have churned.
** (Near Future) Account PLIs - we understand PLI management will be moved to SFDC soon. We need to be able to provide reports which analyze customers with certain PLIs. PLIs affect our SLAs.
** (Near Future) Identification of Recently Upgraded Accounts - allow support to build a process for identifying customers that have upgraded support - so that we can automatically upgrade their existing ticket SLAs.

Regards,

Fred

07/Oct/24 1:28 PM;62f15545e50f2f2a39565bf5;Hi [~accountid:5f0430f810846200156b228c],

Thank you for reaching out to us. As per the guidance of RevOps in latest release (Dated:  19th July 2024) only the users from below department can change account owner of accounts with *Customer* or *Win Back* status

* 211 - Sales Global Admin
* 212 - MM - SLM
* 213 - Area Sales - PWOQ
* 214 - MM - FLM
* 218 - SMB - SLM
* 219 - SMB - FLM
* 247 - ES - SLM
* 248 - ES - FLM
* 281 - Revenue Operations
* 650 - Sales Operations 

So you will either need to connect with HR to get your department updated or take help of your manager to change ownership of accounts.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

Regards,

column1: Stamping Jira Tickets with Existing PLIs from Super Admin
column11:
Hello, we need to stamp Jira tickets (MWTR project) with information regarding the status of certain PLIs. We have the super admin account id (sometimes opportunity id) and we need to know if certain PLIs are active. One example PLI is “Strategic Enterprise Support” (there are several others - some of these are in the process of being created). These PLIs affect our SLAs with the customer and so we need to bring the information onto the ticket.

Is there an endpoint or DB query we can use to get this info out of Super Admin real time in order to stamp a ticket?

NOTE: previously we connected an FH entitlement value to the PLI - but it is not a good solution because some customers don’t purchase the MI platform (i.e. Radarly/Klear only).

This is a fairly urgent request as some of these PLIs went live in mid September and others are going live in mid October.

Thanks in advance.
column16:

Thanks for reaching out to us with this request. BizApps Team has a few questions we want to clarify with you. Jarek and I want to have a quick call with you on this, please let us know your availability.

* Team is asking for business use case.
* Can you elaborate more on what you mean by PLI, is it only for active orders or all the orders?
* Are we talking about PLI level for a given account?
* How do you determine the entitlement associated with the PLI?
* Is this entitlement data available on the MI side? Is this entitlement data not sufficient for the use case?
* What data do you need from the order PLI and do you need the entitlements that are configured on those PLI?

We can discuss this during our call.

Regards,
Navya
column17:
03/Oct/24 10:59 PM;557058:bf99b747-df06-4f96-a03b-0a42637bf91a;Business Use case:

* Escalate incoming tickets (email/chat/portal) based on PLIs purchased by customers. When we see a certain set of PLI’s are active: “Premium Support Enterprise” or “Premium Support Essential” or “Standard+” we would then change the premium support level to a corresponding value. We would also set SLA’s in Jira according to the value. Customers are paying 10k-50k for upgraded support. We must deliver on what was paid for - these tickets cannot be treated like other tickets.

Meaning of PLI:

* We’re searching for active and certain matching PLIs - not a full inventory. It may be helpful to be able to know if something was recently ended (based on the start/end date) as we may need to extend in some scenarios. We may add a grace period into this - but this is not decided or required, yet.

PLI for given account:

* We would like to specify the PLI in our request - but right now it is the following:
** Premium Support Enterprise
** Premium Support Essential
** Standard+
* This may evolve further as Sales designs new campaigns. However, the above is where we are at today.
* Just active PLIs - we don’t need in-active - but it would be nice to know if something was recently ended - or even if it was going to start in the future - so we can add grace periods.

Entitlement for PLI:

* Entitlement is not applicable because we only care about the PLI… these customers exist outside of FH (Radarly/Klear).

Entitlement Data Available:

* See answer above

Order PLI:

Basic (in list form):

PLI Name, Start Date, End Date

Additional for debugging purposes:

PLI_ID, Account_ID, Opportunity_ID

01/Jul/24 10:05 AM;5f3a8eca42959b00397651e9;Hi [~accountid:5ebc1756a4c57d0b8b4cc26f],

Thanks for reaching out to us. Please find the details below:

When the Renewal on a customer account is cancelled, the Renewal opportunity should be marked Closed/Lost. To remove all user access from the MI platform, you need to update the “Configure Access” in Salesforce manually. You should go to the MI Company of the related NewBiz opportunity (for the renewal opportunity) and manually uncheck ‘Allow Login’ Configure Access.
*_Important: Newbiz Opp should never be changed to closed lost in this instance. The Ownership of the Newbiz Opp should also NOT change to the CSM_*

For the Opportunity [Town of Sahuarita - Fairhair - 2133263 - 6 - 2024|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf000001a06LIAQ/view], there is one [renewed order |https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/801Rf000001Z7oXIAS/view]with the order amount of $8000 and the # of months of subscription as 14. 
MRR is Order amount/# of months of subscription

MRR=8000/14=571.43

!image-20240627-190342.png|width=947,height=527,alt="image-20240627-190342.png"!

For the Opportunity  [*Town of Sahuarita - Fairhair - Master - 2196875 - 10 - 2024*|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf000001VX6MIAW/view]  there are two renewed Orders ([Order1|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/801Rf000001ZC8MIAW/view], [Order2|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/801Rf000001ZC8PIAW/view])

MRR is Order amount/#of months of subscription

MRR=1800/4=450 

!image-20240627-191342.png|width=966,height=531,alt="image-20240627-191342.png"!



For [Order2|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/801Rf000001ZC8PIAW/view], the order amount is 13700 and the # of months of subscription is 14.
MRR is Order amount/#of months of subscription 

MRR=13700/14=978.57

!image-20240627-191224.png|width=962,height=533,alt="image-20240627-191224.png"!

Existing Monthly Recurring Revenue is the sum of both the MRRs

Existing Monthly Recurring Revenue = (978.57+450 ) = 1429

This calculation looks correct on both of the opportunities. Please have a look and let me know for any questions or concerns.

Regards,

column1: Investigation | Value of Existing ACV not reflecting in correct currency in Renewal Opportunities
column11:
We have received the below [request|https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04BB2E32M7/p1719201427663329] from Huixian Yang on the #salesforce-go-live channel.

{quote}Hi team, we have 3 accounts in Salesforce where the ACV is showing the figure in USD, when it should be JPY. As a result, the figures are overinflated. Can you look into this please?For example: [TOYOTA CONIQ Pro - Explore for SL|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf000009s2VfIAI/view] has an ACV of 4.6M USD but the order is JPY 4.6M.Other similar accounts:

* [Mitsubishi|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf000008nOZVIA2/view]
* [Nielsen Sports|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf000001U6xrIAC/view]{quote}

We checked and found that for [TOYOTA CONIQ Pro - Explore for SL|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/006Rf000009s2VfIAI/view], [the corresponding order|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801Rf00000B7lTpIAJ/view] (due to which renewal opportunity was created) has value in the correct currency, but the same is not reflected in the renewal opportunity.
column16:
25/Jun/24 8:02 AM;62f15545e50f2f2a39565bf5;We have investigated these 3 cases above, the users updated the opportunity currency to USD and *Salesforce does not recalculate currency fields on change of currency.*

*Case 1:*
Account Currency is JPY
Order Amount on Renewed Orders is JPY
Existing Annual Contract Value is JPY
The user changed the opportunity currency from JPY to USD on March 27, 2024.
*Case 2:*
Account Currency is JPY
Order Amount on Renewed Orders is JPY
Existing Annual Contract Value is JPY
The user changed the opportunity currency from JPY to USD on March 14, 2024.
*Case 3:*
Account Currency is JPY
Order Amount on Renewed Orders is JPY
Existing Annual Contract Value is JPY
The user changed the opportunity currency from JPY to USD on December 12, 2023.Users can change the currency back to the original currency then it'll be correct.

Thank you for reaching out to us, as we checked ACV is calculated on below formula (suggested and confirmed) by RevOps.

* If # of Months in a Subscription is greater than 12

{quote}ACV = (Bookings (TCV)/# of Months in Subscription)*12 {quote}

* If # of Months in a Subscription is less than 12

{quote}ACV= Bookings (TCV){quote}

So for the above opportunity Bookings (TCV)=EUR 24,920.00 and # of Months in Subscription=23

Hence ACV=EUR 13,001.74

column1: Google Ads/SFDC Integration Data Discrepancies
column11:
Hey Team, excited about the prospect of this coming together with your help…

We have integrated Google Ads and SFDC with the help of Google’s Tech Support team but it seems there are some discrepancies in the data being passed between SFDC and Google Ads. I should have requested your assistance from the beginning. +Please let me know the best way to go about scheduling! Google Tech usually requests three available dates or I can just copy someone from BizApps on the email to coordinate.+

Here is the deck Google provided as a resource: [https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/14dgGdFx72Kqe7yFHOH1V-40CWxDK35XuSpXRTpFMOW8/edit?usp=sharing|https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/14dgGdFx72Kqe7yFHOH1V-40CWxDK35XuSpXRTpFMOW8/edit?usp=sharing|smart-link] 

Is it because our SFDC hygiene is not as clean as it should be? is it because of users declining cookies? I just don’t know and it seems it could be too many factors that I am not smart enough to figure out!



This is what we thought we needed to do so we did each step:

*Preparing Google Ads (ganztags.)*

* Ensure that auto tagging is active for all campaigns (I think this is the default setting but we will double check)
* Create a new conversion goal on MCC level (type: import -> track conversions from clicks)
* Slide 16

*Preparing forms (Meltwater)*

* Modify forms on the website to collect GCLID (hidden field)
* Slide 17

*Preparing Tags (ganztags.)*

* Implementing a script thats extracts GCLID from ad clicks
* pass GCLID to form on submit
* Slide 19

*_Sidenote_*_: When users decline cookies, we won't be sending the GCLID to salesforce._

*Prepare CRM (Meltwater)*

* make sure CRM captures GCLID
* Set up conversion import (use salesforce integration)
* Slide 18 / 23

*Change bidding strategies & goals (ganztags.)*

* wait for a couple of weeks for the new conversion goal to collect data
* change bidding strategies to optimize towards the new goal
* Slide 32

THANK YOU SO MUCH! This will be incredibly amazing to get figured out and I have been working on it over a year 😞

Thank you for reaching out to us, as per the guidance of RevOps, when a customer account is cancelled, the Renewal opportunity should be marked Closed/Lost. To remove all user access from the MI platform, you need to update the “Configure Access” in Salesforce manually. You should go to the MI Company of the related NewBiz opportunity (for the renewal opportunity) and manually uncheck ‘Allow Login’ Configure Access.

*_Important: Newbiz Opp should never be changed to closed lost in this instance. The Ownership of the Newbiz Opp should also NOT change to the CSM_* 

However, if you still want us to move the stage of opportunity to Closed/Lost, we need the approval of RevOps for it.

column1: Moonraker PR - MRR Showing in USD on Admin Page
column11:
Hi team, 

I have raised this issue with Michelle Alvarado and Matt Papadopoulos and they requested I raise a ticket here as well. 

Historically, in Canada whether a deal was sold in CAD or USD, the number that shows on the account page for MRR was always the CAD equivalent. For Moonraker, the most recent deal was sold in CAD for $4,400 (MRR = 366$CAD) but the MRR on admin is showing as the USD equivalent (265$). I am wondering why this is the case now and if we can fix it? 

The issue this presents is because we are also dealing with CAD / USD discrepancies from a currency conversion stand point, Matt Burton has instructed me to tell my reps if they sell a deal in USD to use the CAD MRR conversion that shows in admin. which now I am worried is not accurate if some are CAD conversions and some are USD conversions. 

Please advise on how to best proceed!

Thank you

Jordan

* The order was created by you (Jordan Trimble with SalesOffice as CS Americas North Admin) where as the Opportunity/Account Owner Carstin Hao from Americas Admin Sales Office has Office currency in USD.

09/May/24 8:21 PM;557058:7d68ed67-77bf-45e2-91bc-5fe785cb8ec7;Just to give you some background on our use cases. Product Support is always in Superadmin while working on tickets for many, many reasons. Some highlights:

* More and more requests are coming in with Salesforce links (UUID) which is a huge issue as the team needs to try to track this down or it causes a delay while we wait to hear back from sales.
* Radarly Back Office now requires the UUID number from Salesforce when making updates to some project settings like expiration dates. So we have to track down export lists for all Radarly accounts and keep them updated.
* Klear engineering is making changes to the Admin Panel (backend) that will have SF references that Support can’t access.
* This is becoming more and more of an issue. We are starting to plan our integration with SF for our ticket automation, but even that will cause more issues once rolled out for our team on the ground who need to log into accounts and look things up on a per ticket basis. So we won’t be able to roll it out until we have access to Salesforce for the broader team.

Let me know if you need more info, thx!

column11:

column16:
30/Apr/24 5:15 PM;62f15545e50f2f2a39565bf5;Hi [~accountid:5ebc0f354e41b90b7b541678],

As per the guidance of RevOps. When the Renewal on a customer account is cancelled, the Renewal opportunity should be marked Closed/Lost. *To remove all user access from the MI platform, you need to update the “Configure Access” in Salesforce manually.* *You should go to the MI Company of the related NewBiz opportunity (for the renewal opportunity) and manually uncheck ‘Allow Login’ Configure Access*.

*_Important: Newbiz Opp should never be changed to closed lost in this instance. The Ownership of the Newbiz Opp should also NOT change to the CSM_*

column16:
25/Apr/24 3:55 PM;5f3a8eca42959b00397651e9;As checked with [@Animesh M|https://meltwater.slack.com/team/UAMB6JK6W]

* In Super Admin, we have only *Decision Maker,* and rest are mapped as *Other*
* That is why, the *Champion* role changes to *Other* when SA to SF sync occurs
* As a solution, we should not sync the contact roles from SA to SF
column17:
15/May/24 9:44 AM;5f3a8eca42959b00397651e9;In super admin, we have only 2 options for Contact Roles, one is Decision Maker and another is Other.
Now if a user picks Champion as a contact role in the salesforce, it would change to Other, if SA to SF sync occurs(for any reason) because it considers it as Other in the super admin as Champion is not there.
So in the next release, SA to SF sync will be stopped so that there will be no impact on the contact roles in the SF and all the contact roles remain as it is in the SF.

We will stop *SA <> SFDC* sync for ContactOpportunityRole in the next release tentative on May 17 at 6 PM PST.

I got a series of emails from Salesforce re: Opportunity Automation - No Activity For 14 Days. It’s regarding [this Opportunity|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/0065f00000IrfChAAJ/view], among a couple of others.

column16:
24/Apr/24 11:06 AM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Elaine,

Making the Opportunity CLosed/Lost will not revoke the MI Application access. MI App access can be revoked via “Configure Access” tab.

Please check the instruction from RevOps on below post:
[https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04BB2E32M7/p1707914722273919|https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04BB2E32M7/p1707914722273919|smart-link]

* There have been a few questions on how to 'deactivate' clients or trials in Salesforce:When the Renewal on a customer account is cancelled, the Renewal opportunity should be marked Closed/Lost. To remove all user access from the MI platform, you need to update the “Configure Access” in Salesforce manually. You should go to the MI Company of the related NewBiz opportunity (for the renewal opportunity) and manually uncheck ‘Allow Login’ Configure Access.
* *_Important: Newbiz Opp should never be changed to closed lost in this instance. The Ownership of the Newbiz Opp should also NOT change to the CSM_*Walkthrough Deck: [Platform Deactivation|https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1q5-IDlbcKS3kPwjuTpKAR7wWVpeOIZxmieN_sfyATHw/edit?usp=sharing]
Video Walkthrough: [Platform Deactivation|https://meltwater.skillshood.com/huddle/395557/videos/814930]

You can discuss this with RevOps if you have any questions.

Thanks,
Mukesh

Hi team

I’m reaching out to ask for assistance with an issue we have been identifying in EMEA. I do not have SF access as I’m not in Sales, however this is happening across different offices and I’m looking for a more efficient way to solve this issue.



Since the deactivation of some features in Superadmin (and subsequent moving of those to SF), we have noticed that some new customers end up with *two opportunities in closed/won status on Superadmin (and therefore salesforce).* The result of this is duplicate opportunities(working levels) in Totango which is causing issues for CS (and our team, Onboarding & Adoption, office 275) in that:

* customers reflect can as churned
* No MRR shows
* No active users show

As such, this means that our projects are impacted and also the CS base is impacted.

17/Apr/24 11:39 AM;5f3a8eca42959b00397651e9;Hi [~accountid:5dea7c48d129c00cd95fbd3a],

We have checked with Jeremy and found that when we update renewal opportunities, they are triggering the update on new business opportunities which results in an update of the impact date.

Here are the details below:

----

While uploading the data, we found that there is a [flow|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/builder_platform_interaction/flowBuilder.app?flowId=301Rf00000CDLkeIAH], that is updating the field impact date with the current date. The flow will execute when we do any update except changing the impact date. It will execute even if we click on edit and just save it.

* In our case, many renewal opportunities are triggering the update on new business opportunities which results in an update of the impact date.

*Example:-* [https://meltwater--fullsb.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/0065f00000IrzsVAAR/view|https://meltwater--fullsb.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Opportunity/0065f00000IrzsVAAR/view|smart-link]

22/Mar/24 9:43 AM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Andrew,

As per the current implementation, the Claim date update process runs whenever:

* The claim date is blank and the account got updated *or* the account owner gets changed.

In the above case, the claim date on the account was blank and the account got updated indirectly via the process (even if we just click on Edit button on Account/opportunity/contact and save either on Salesforce or Super Admin) which triggered with the current date on account's claim date field on March 11, 2024.


In short: when the claim date is blank on any account, it will be set to the current date once any account entity is edited/saved. Once the claim date is set then it will only change when the account owner gets updated.

Let me know if you have any questions.

Thanks,
Mukesh

column1: Request for Formal Permission/Approval for OpFocus Team to work in Salesforce Production on Vonage Build
column11:
Below is the request from OpFocus Team:


{quote}Pooja and Robin,

I am writing as a result of the IT team meeting today, requesting formal permission to work in Production on the Vonage build. 

With no inbound or outbound calling capabilities in Full Sandbox, we cannot build or test many features. An even bigger concern is that UAT isn't possible by end users either, which is a requirement for the standard deployment process. The end result of our meeting was that an exception is needed to the process 

To accomplish our goals, there are three types of Production updates we need to perform: Data/Records, Config and Deployments

We reviewed these in detail with Shailendra and team today, articulated the risks and how we intend to mitigate them, and I've summarized them in detail below. Please let me know if you have any questions or would like to discuss concerns and I'm happy to address. 

Once we get a green light, we can start making progress and getting things into Robin's hands for feedback. 

Thanks,

Matt



Data / Record Updates

We will need a test Account and Contacts, and ideally the ability to create multiple contacts and opportunities. 

We will need to create List Views that are Private, but can be publicly exposed.

We will need to create Reports and Dashboards in a private folder

To configure outbound caller ID / number presentation, we need to create two types of Vonage custom records for Domestic and International routing. When these records are created, if an End User selects '--auto--'

Risk Mitigations: 

Obtain authorization prior to making these updates (via Jira confirmation)

Inform the MW Teams when updates start and finish (Slack and log in Jira)

Immediate validation by Meltwater (Slack)

Ensure users continue to manually select Callback Number until functionality is validated 

Config Updates

When we need to build things via Salesforce Setup/Admin directly. 

An example is a new enhanced Lightning Record Page for Contacts with Vonage Call Logs, or a Supervisor View page. 

Or working on the Supervisor view for managing calls, and seeing agents call logs. We need calling Data in the system to see how our configuration responds. In FullSB, we are blind. 

Risk Mitigations

Create a new "Vonage Workshop" app, accessible to Admins only

Do all work in here, new pages are only viewable by Admins

Do not touch any in place Objects or Configurations (such as page layouts). Only build net new items

Clone flows and work on new versions in Debug mode. 

Clear and Transparent communication about updates via Slack and Jira tagging

Obtain formal approval for Activating new flows or other automations

Change Set Deployments

A majority of the build will be done in Production, yet some components may be made in FullSB (if they can be thoroughly UAT'd by end users) . 

When we need to deploy a change set to production, we will follow Meltwater's standard IT procedures, which is thorough and has ample risk controls built in. 

Since some build components will be done in Production, we will need to send a change set DOWN to Full Sandbox once the solution is fully in place and operational. 

Risk Mitigations

Follow Standard Operating Procedure {quote}

The Salesforce Production Deployment is planned for March 4, 2024. Please get the approval from [~accountid:5dea7c48d129c00cd95fbd3a]

20/Mar/24 1:09 AM;712020:a3502535-926c-4f53-abe5-c6a0cf8d06ff;Currently these fields are data type of Date. There is a request to change them to data type of Date/Time. This will require first backing up these fields, then transforming the data to reflect the standard Salesforce Date/Time format of:

YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss

We will already have the YYYY-MM-DD component from the fields. For the hh:mm:ss we will just insert zeros like 00:00:00. So for example a record that currently has a First SQO Date of 2023-11-1 would need to be transformed to a new value of 2023-11-1 00:00:00 in the upload file (00:00:00 = 12AM midnight).

Once the data is backed up and transformed to the new format, the fields can then be changed in Salesforce to Date/Time data type. Immediately after that is finished, the data load of existing records will need to take place to preserve the data needed for the Opportunity Snapshots which are generated every day.

column1: Add a 'Meeting Set Date' field to an opportunity (Date Numeric)
column11:
Hi team,

As next year the BDR global org is moving to a ‘SQL’ based recognition role, it’s crucial we have the right reports in place to track opportunities and their movement in the salescycle.

Currently we have trouble cleary identifying opportunities generated by BDR’s, that have a meeting date set (and passed), but not converted yet in the sales stages by their respective AE.

As an industry standard in other tech sales companies, having a ‘Meeting Set Date’ as a field on an opportunity that needs to be filled by the BDR upon opportunity creation (date is same date as meeting date booked for AE), allows mgmt to generate reports to find those opps that; IF Opportunity created + Meeting Date has passed, but NOT moved to Demo+ Stage then show in report. 
Can we please introduce this ASAP, as it will be crucial to do hygiene checks in the business as well as it has a direct correlation to BDR commission and payment.

Thanks!

{noformat}Hi team,

@Shailendra Singh, thanks for your time on the phone earlier to help us formulate a plan.  Here is a summary of what we discussed and the actions I have now taken in Marketo.

- The high sync volume was triggered by a bulk upload of nearly 50,000 customer records to Marketo from Planhat.  There are a handful of Marketo programs that fire when a new record is created, and those programs also include a forced "sync to SF" step. The combination of those things was causing this large number of records to attempt to create/update in Salesforce repeatedly, spiking the number of API calls.

- I have removed the forced "sync to SF" step from those programs that fire when a new record is created.  This will prevent future bulk uploads of customer data from repeating this continuous update scenario.

- My team will do a complete audit of all Marketo programs that use this "sync to SF" step and remove any that are not operationally required.

- I believe a notification is being set up via Salesforce to alert your team when API usage increases.  Unfortunately there is no mechanism to do this on the Marketo side, so we will need to rely on your team to inform us as soon as you see any kind of spike, so we can address it before it reaches a critical stage.

- We are now ready for you to un-freeze the Marketo Integration user.  There is a backlog of data that will need to sync over, so you can expect to see some number of API calls as it catches up over the next couple of hours, but it should be nowhere near the critical volume of earlier.

Please let me know when the user is reset so I can manually push over the MQLs that are pending.

Thank you all for your support,
Amy

column1: Change First MQL Date,First SAL Date,First SQL Date, and First SQO Date to Date/Time field type on the Opportunity and Opportunity Snapshot object
column11:
Currently these fields are data type of Date.  There is a request to change them to data type of Date/Time.  This will require first backing up these fields for all Opportunity and Opportunity Snapshot records, then transforming the data to reflect the standard Salesforce Date/Time format of:

YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss

We will already have the YYYY-MM-DD component from the fields.  For the hh:mm:ss we will just insert zeros like 00:00:00.  So for example a record that currently has a First SQO Date of 2023-11-1 would need to be transformed to a new value of 2023-11-1 00:00:00 in the upload file (00:00:00 = 12AM midnight). 

Once the data is backed up and transformed to the new format, the fields can then be changed in Salesforce to Date/Time data type.  Immediately after that is finished, the data load of existing records will need to take place to preserve the data needed for the Opportunity Snapshots which are generated every day.

[Here is a spreadsheet that can be used for testing the data load in UAT once the data type has been changed for the fields.|https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Nh8e5s8FQvFJSUsdLKs-c_Ue7IhfyhBFv295ldo9WXw/edit#gid=0]

column18:
25/Aug/23 6:25 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Andrew,

Please find the answers as below:

# The report used is standard Opportunity report and the field WD Sales Office is used as a filter in the dashboard. This field is a picklist and hence it shows as list value. Since Madrid does not exist in the list value, It cannot be selected.
# As mentioned in comment 1, in [Dashboard 1|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Dashboard/01Z5f000000qeKsEAI/view] the field used is a picklist field. Hence it shows as a list whereas in the [Tofu dashboard|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Dashboard/01Z5f000000ZmZvEAK/view?queryScope=userFolders] the sales office of the person is directly not available in the standard report. So a custom field is created to store the sales office of the person who created the activity. Since we cannot create a formula field as a picklist, so it acts as text form.

Let me know if you have any further questions.

Thanks,

Mukesh Palsaniya

column1: Account "Description" Input Box at Fields to Display & Filter Box in Salesforce
column11:
We have a request from Rob Smith(Sales Consultant) as below:

----

Hi team, Is there any way to add the Account "Description" input  box to both the

* Fields to Display
* Filter Box

He is trying to create an easy accounts list that can have simple inputs such as a "hit list" or other ways to prioritize accounts without changing the account name.

!image-20230720-123237.png|width=50%!

Ref: [https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04BB2E32M7/p1689835981887979|https://meltwater.slack.com/archives/C04BB2E32M7/p1689835981887979|smart-link]
column16:
21/Jul/23 2:38 PM;5f3a8eca42959b00397651e9;*Investigation:(*Investigated by Paras*)*

* The team has connected with salesforce support and as per them Description is a Standard field on Contact and account
* To see the standard *Description* field on the List view, we have to create a custom description field Even though both are of type long text area. 
* On Contact, there is already a description custom field but not there on the account, that's why users are not able to see the field on Account.

!Screenshot (7318)-20230721-090446.png|width=1366,height=645!

* for now, to differentiate the field we have changed the label from description to description1 for the custom field on contact.
* As the description(both custom and standard) is a long text area it will not be available for filter.

*Solution:(*suggested by Priya*)*

*  Since the long Description field will not work, there are 2 options here:
*# We could create a regular text field with a 255-character limit which the user can then filter in list views etc. This will provide the most customizable solution for reps.
*# We ask RevOps to provide a list of picklist values (such as “Hit List”) that can be used in a multi-select picklist field and filtered in list views. This option will be more consistent for all reps, and can include an “Other” option if necessary with a separate “Other” text field (255 character limit).

----

* I had a discussion with the user. As per him he only wants the limit of 50 characters. Hence the first option is looking more reliable.
* As I checked, the team is working on a related task via [https://meltwater.atlassian.net/browse/SFDC-5377|https://meltwater.atlassian.net/browse/SFDC-5377|smart-link]. 
* For now, I have updated the user that this request is under backlog.

Happy to walk you through on screensharing. This is the “test contact” i have been using [https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Contact/0035f00001eE4BVAA0/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Contact/0035f00001eE4BVAA0/view|smart-link]

column18:
20/Jul/23 3:23 PM;62f15545e50f2f2a39565bf5;Hi [~accountid:5ebc092aed4a650b8e7c83d3],

Thank you for your patience. Please find the answers to your questions below:

*Q1:* If a call is not answered it cannot be saved to salesforce

*Ans:* This is a Salesforce feature. Salesforce does not save unanswered calls.

*Q2:* Also, recently it is not telling the difference of whether it has been answered or not. (I answered the call and it still showed up as unanswered)

*Ans:* After every successful call, select one option from the dropdown list ‘SELECT CALL RESULT’, and save it. Then only you can see the details associated with it.

!OLAynSULCBRUVNFCq_DoQq2fPT9vyamfJgwrimzuMHiEIIqrsy6BIinR_GNE02MEpAlvLxm32cJPO1OymQgnYQtTo0UrFRGSM5teaoXu3OzNimyDP70Gy3v9wHMrwjIW7Sp7Kf50uQ4Q2MRa7pEZjz8|width=50%!

 *Q3:* How come an outbound call is the only choice when logging it? I think maybe the selection ability is not working properly (it shows later in the way the activity is automatically logged).

*Ans:* Since Salesforce automatically logs the tasks on behalf of the call made after each and every call. That’s why it shows later in the way the activity is automatically logged.

*Q4:* The call result options are also not complete and not the same as "call disposition in Salesforce" making it very difficult for reporting later.

*Ans:* This is a Salesforce inbuilt feature, We can’t change the list of values for the call result option.

*Q5: I*t is able to tell that a call was answered and it automatically logged it as a call to salesforce, however, it showed up as an "upcoming and overdue task" even though the status of it is "closed". Can we make these show as completed tasks automatically?

*Ans:* This issue has already been logged by a user and as a resolution, we are making all the answered call status as ‘Completed’. This will be deployed on production in this upcoming release which is on the 21st of July. 

*Q6:* When the answered call was automatically logged, it showed a very strange activity type as well. It looks like it just added all options to the type 

*Ans:* Yeah the observation is correct. We are working on this.

column1: Please exclude Marketing Admin profile from all validation rules (current and future)
column11:
The Marketo integration profile, *Marketing Admin*, should be excluded from all validation rules created in Salesforce (current rules as well as all rules created in the future, across all objects).

Validation rules are meant to enforce good business practice with manual data entry.  There are many scenarios in which the integration user would need to bypass these rules (current scenario of unqualified reason validation rules, as an example).  It is difficult to predict how a validation rule might cause an error with the Marketo integration, but it could lead to data (leads, MQLs, data updates) not passing successfully from Marketo to Salesforce, with no option for human intervention.  Overall this practice offers more reward than risk.  

For reference, this request was added to the Marketing Requirements doc, Open Items tab, on March 1st.

column11:
Opportunties that have been ticked as ‘feeling lucky’, ‘strong’, ‘pipeline’ etc. are popping up under wrong categories in Forecast tab. 

If a case is set to ‘Evaluate’ stage, it is always appearing under ‘Strong’. This is not supporting the sales forecasting currently.

column18:
24/May/23 6:07 PM;5f3a8eca42959b00397651e9;Current setup.
*Probability    Forecast Category*
0%                 Omitted
5%                 Pipeline
15%              Feeling Lucky
50%              Strong
75%              Commit
100%            Closed

----

* As we checked the setup is correct as it is based on Forecast Category.
* As per Juri, the problem is, the forecast category is wrong
* It shouldn't be "Forecast Category: Strong" if the case has been set as "Forecast Strenght: Feeling Lucky"
* We suggested that it is not about Forecast strength as it is based on Probability
* Juri said the issue is, Probability isn't changing
* If the case is let's say 'Evaluate' probability is always 50% while 'Forecast Category' is Strong, even though 'Forecast Strenght' and/or 'Manager Forecast Override' would be set Feeling Lucky
* If Forecast Strenght or Manager Forecast override is set, it should impact 'Probability'

!image-20230524-123620.png|width=718,height=170!

# Green is how it is now - Orange is how it should be
# So now it can be 'Evaluate' and it's always strong, but Evaluate can be forecast strength Feeling Lucky -> probability should be 15%
# Currently:Stage = Forecast Category & Probability
# but it should be forecast Strenght OR Manager Forecast Override = Forecast Category & Probability

----
column19:
25/May/23 5:18 PM;5f3a8eca42959b00397651e9;Hi Juri,

Thanks for your patience. Please find the details below:

* We would like to share with you that currently, we have one forecasting type which uses the Quota Sales Forecast field and another one that uses the Amount field (this amount is automatically calculated by the amounts listed on the products the user enters for the opportunity).
* The forecast type only allows you to choose one field, which must be a number or currency field, so the *Manager Forecast Override and Forecast Strength fields don’t appear here as options.*
* Generally, we choose Close Date to group the opportunities.
* There is an optional filter section that will allow you to set up to 3 filters. These filters include fields like the Manager Forecast Override and Forecast Strength fields, but the *filter would apply to ALL opportunities which appear in the forecast tab.*
* So if we say we only want to see forecasts which have a Manager Forecast Override for “Commit”, then no other opportunities will appear in the dashboard.
* And unfortunately, there’s no way to line up the Manager Forecast Override with the different columns.

!image-20230525-114416.png|width=742,height=251!

* As you have already seen, the forecast category and probability percentages are set on the Stage field in the opportunity object, not the Forecast settings so we don’t really have a way to adjust this based on the Manager or Rep’s forecasted value.
* The probability and forecast category will only be updated based on the actual sales stage that the opportunity is in.
* The fields for Manager Override and Forecast Strength are meant to allow users to provide their own input, but this will not affect how opportunities appear in the forecast dashboard itself.

----

Please have a look and let us know if we are missing something.

Thanks,
Ayush

column1: Client Churn/closed events
column11:
Hi, team Horace are working on a new component which involves keeping track of saved searches. To keep a clean state, we also want to be aware of when customers churn or go to sales stage - closed (or for any other reason which indicates that we no longer need to keep track of their saved searches).

We have heard that you publish events to warp zone ([https://github.com/meltwater/warp-zone-api/blob/master/docs/payloads.md|https://github.com/meltwater/warp-zone-api/blob/master/docs/payloads.md#client-data-notification---superadmin-team]) and were wondering which events we need to care about for our use-case? That is, which events do we need to listen to, to learn about customers that are no longer active?

Best regards,

David Burke (Team Lead @ Horace)
column16:

column18:
18/May/23 9:58 AM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi David,

Events are currently not triggered from Client Data Notification and thus not available.

We have another WZ event documented at [https://github.com/meltwater/warp-zone-api/blob/master/docs/payloads.md#sa-companies---superadmin-team|https://github.com/meltwater/warp-zone-api/blob/master/docs/payloads.md#sa-companies---superadmin-team]

Payload contains ARR field. When there are no active orders, the value of ARR will be 0 but that customer can churn-return and may require their search again. Please see if this works for your use case.

Thanks,
Mukesh

column11:
*Re: Duplicate Rules*

A workaround to changing the duplicate rules for everyone is to simply make the Marketing Admin profile except from the rules.There are 5 sets of duplicate rules.

* Standard Account Duplicate Rule
* Standard Contact Duplicate Rule
* Standard Lead Duplicate Rule
* Standard Rule for Contacts with Duplicate Leads
* Standard Rule for Leads with Duplicate Contacts



The proposed change should be made in all but the Account rule (see screenshot 3). (Because Marketo does not create/update Account records).



The proposed change would *add a Condition to these 4 rule sets that "User Profile does not equal Marketing Admin"* (see screenshot 4).



This allows Marketo to create records as needed while still restricting other users.

16/Mar/23 10:26 AM;62f15545e50f2f2a39565bf5;Hi [~accountid:628eb8ebc65b72006962713f] and [~accountid:623c09c6a9575800695ac88d] 

Here’s the BASD ticket we have created for the issue.

We were able to follow the issue.

What we could understand is Leads synced from Marketo to SF are having assigned countries as the United States.
But we checked many lead records which are being assigned country.
*If the country is not assigned to Lead it is assigned as the United States. (Default country)*

We also see they are being assigned in different queues.

Queue: MI & Social (France) [https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Lead/00Q5f00000OxY43EAF/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Lead/00Q5f00000OxY43EAF/view]

Queue : MI & Social (DACH): [https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Lead/00Q5f00000OxaOFEAZ/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Lead/00Q5f00000OxaOFEAZ/view]

Queue: Marketing Inbounds: [https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Lead/00Q5f00000OxaiKEAR/view|https://meltwater.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Lead/00Q5f00000OxaiKEAR/view]

Would you please explain the issue

Thanks
column18:
16/Mar/23 4:56 PM;623c09c6a9575800695ac88d;That's not exactly the issue. 
* When data was migrated from Super Admin to Salesforce, if any country was blank for any record, it was given a default value of United States. This data then synced to Marketo (to a new, empty Marketo instance). 
* We noticed when building a list in this new Marketo that we suddenly had over 1m records with US as the country, when the real number based on our old instance was 350k. 
** NOTE: Salesforce and Marketo were not an exact match in terms of records. There were some in Salesforce that we did not previously have in Marketo, and about 60k in our old Marketo that were not present in Salesforce when we did the initial sync to new Marketo. So we would expect some discrepancy, but not 1m records. 
* We have since updated our new Marketo with the country data for non-US countries that we had in our old Marketo. 
 *The remaining issues:* 
* We still have 850k records with United States as the country. That is the 350k we previously had in our old Marketo database, plus another 500k that came from Salesforce and we don't know if the country is really US or if that was a default given because the record was blank. 
* We cannot have United States be the default country when creating new records. This creates issues with email marketing compliance. US is fair game and we can email them without consent, but if anyone is actually in an EU country, we are in violation of GDPR and if reported, the company can face steep penalties.

column1: Pipe count not matching in Salesforce and Super Admin
column11:
We got requests on Slack channel #salesforce-rollout-phase1 for the pipe count mismatch in Saleasforce and Super Admin.

Users who raised this request:

*David Yu*

*Sakshi jain*

*Oliver Coren*

*Kim*

*Zainab*

*Ala' Armoush*

*Resolution/Root cause provided:* 
Issue happened due to the migration criteria from Super Admin to Salesforce:

* Active accounts (all accounts with a currently active subscription where max subscription end date > today) OR
* Accounts with an active subscription in the past 7 years OR
* Account Type ‘Prospect’ *(Last 3 Years)* OR
* There is a Note, Task, or Activity created on the Account/Opportunity in the past 2 years. OR
* Any opportunities in the account with “Days in stage” < 1 year

13/Mar/23 5:50 PM;557058:d2f6b80a-00e2-4d78-a014-e0b79fae0975;Hi Jake,

We have updated the filters for the list “My Accounts”, So all the accounts should be showing that comes under below criteria:

* Active accounts (all accounts with a currently active subscription where max subscription end date > today) OR
* Accounts with an active subscription in the past 7 years OR
* Account Type ‘Prospect’ *(Last 3 Years)* OR

We would like to share with you that the “owner” of an Opportunity in Superadmin has no effect on the ability of the corresponding user log in as that company in the MI app.  In order for the company to appear on an internal user’s list when the user logs in, the user must be listed as a “user” (as opposed to the “owner”) in the opportunity.
